item.title: U.S. Supreme Court weighs local governments’ climate change lawsuits against oil and gas companies
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court grappled with whether local governments can sue oil and gas companies to help cover costs associated with climate change.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Supreme Court grappled Monday with whether local governments can sue oil and gas companies in state court to help cover costs associated with climate change, an issue with potentially billions of dollars at stake. Key justices appeared wary about the potential sweep of litigation, but torn over the complex questions of federal and state law raised by the case. Officials in Boulder argue their lawsuit is an attempt to hold energy companies Suncor and ExxonMobil accountable for their contributions to climate change. They say that worsening disasters such as floods and wildfires put a heavy financial burden on local communities, and the industry should bear part of that cost. The city and county of Boulder first sued the oil companies in 2018, years before the 2021 Marshall Fire destroyed nearly 1,100 homes and left two people dead. Total damage was estimated at US$2 billion, the costliest wildfire in Colorado history. The companies say that a flurry of lawsuits in state courts is not the way to deal with the global issue. Boulder case is part of a wave of legal action against oil companies Governments from largely blue-leaning areas around the country have filed similar lawsuits seeking damages that could total billions of dollars, part of a wave of legal action worldwide seeking to leverage action through the courts. “Presumably, if you prevail, the next day, a municipality in every single state will file a lawsuit,” said Chief Justice John Roberts. “How do you think that will work out on the ground?” Justice Brett Kavanaugh said a win by Boulder could bankrupt the oil companies and other potential defendants. “I mean, anyone is a potential defendant for a suit like this. Any manufacturer, any business,’’ he said. A win for the oil and gas companies at the Supreme Court, meanwhile, could shut down dozens of similar cases filed in recent years. Suncor and Exxon argue that the Clean Air Act gives the federal government – not the states – the power to regulate emissions. They have the support of the Trump administration, which argues the lawsuits are an unconstitutional attempt to regulate planet-warming emissions and impose Colorado’s state law beyond its borders. But Roberts and other justices pointed out that state courts consider lawsuits about a myriad of issues that have nationwide reach. “I guess I’m not quite sure what makes this situation different from those,” Roberts said. The court is also weighing a jurisdictional question that could allow it an “off-ramp” to avoid deciding the issues right away. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson seemed like a vote in favor of that path. “Why shouldn’t we wait and hear all of these claims once the state courts are done?” she asked. Alito absent due to ethics recusal The case was heard without Justice Samuel Alito, who recused himself just a week before arguments after facing calls to step aside because he owns stock in oil companies. That raises the possibility of a tie vote. A deadlock would leave in place a decision from Colorado’s highest court allowing the case to proceed. Attorney Kannon Shanmugam, representing the industry, urged the justices to reverse that ruling. He said the Boulder case was attempting to use the courts to decide a public policy issue that is properly up to Congress and other elected officials. “Climate change is certainly one of the most pressing issues” facing the country, but the lawsuit “is exactly the wrong way to go about” addressing it, he said. Principal Deputy Solicitor General Sarah Harris said Boulder’s case “egregiously exceeds” the state’s authority. The county essentially declares itself a victim of actions that occurred largely out of state, she said. But Kevin Russell, an attorney representing Boulder, argued that state lawsuits can address damage in Colorado, regardless where the fossil fuels are produced. Boulder is not trying to regulate greenhouse gas emissions or stop the companies from continuing to produce oil and gas, Russell said. Instead officials are seeking to hold the companies accountable for allegedly misleading the public about their contribution to global warming by burning fossil fuels, he said. “Chapter 3” of the case trilogy, after tobacco and opioids Justice Elena Kagan compared the climate case to previous state-based lawsuits against the tobacco industry and opioid makers. “This is Chapter 3,” she said, noting the similarities of states claiming harms from products produced nationally and even internationally. “This is a different book,″ replied Shanmugam, the industry lawyer. Harms claimed by Boulder “are diffused nationwide and indeed worldwide,” he said. Trump’s Republican administration has rolled back environmental regulations, including a move last month by the Environmental Protection Agency to repeal rules that limit emissions from power plants fueled by coal and natural gas. States and cities have already sued over the repeal of the power plant rule. The conservative-majority Supreme Court has been skeptical of environmental regulations in the past, including in a 2022 decision limiting the EPA’s authority to regulate carbon dioxide emissions from power plants. A decision is expected in the coming months. ___ Lindsay Whitehurst and Matthew Daly, The Associated Press Associated Press writer Nicholas Riccardi in Denver contributed to this story.

item.title: Data centre operator DayOne reveals revenue surge in US IPO filing
item.description: Data center operator DayOne Data Centers filed for an initial public offering in the United States on Monday, testing investor appetite for data-center listings amid challenging market conditions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Data center operator DayOne Data Centers filed for an initial public offering in the United States on Monday, testing investor appetite for data-center listings amid challenging market conditions. The company posted a net loss of $77.2 million on revenue of $512 million for the six months ended June 30, compared with a loss of $12.6 million on revenue of $151.5 million a year earlier. The filing comes as surging bond yields and elevated interest rates cloud the outlook for the fall IPO market, prompting several major listings to be [USN:L6N45L0OG TEXT:"postponed"]. Data centers have also come under scrutiny over their heavy use of electricity, water and land, with communities raising concerns about their impact on power grids, utility bills and local resources. The Singapore-based company develops and operates data centers for cloud-computing and AI customers, providing space, power, cooling and connectivity, primarily under long-term contracts. DayOne operates across Asia-Pacific and Europe, including Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, Japan, Finland and Spain, according to its filing. Shanghai-based GDS Holdings set up GDS International in Singapore in 2022, which was rebranded as DayOne in January 2025 following its separation from the parent company. The company has not disclosed the size of the offering, although Reuters [USN:L4N3Z90C5 TEXT:"reported"] in February that it was aiming to raise as much as $5 billion at a potential valuation of $20 billion. DayOne plans to use the IPO proceeds to develop and construct new data-center projects and for working capital and other general corporate purposes. Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities and Citigroup are among the underwriters for the offering. DayOne plans to list its American depositary shares on the Nasdaq under the symbol “DODC.”

item.title: Conservation group calls for moratorium on AI data centers on US public lands
item.description: Conservation group The Wilderness Society on Monday called for a moratorium on artificial intelligence data centers on federal lands, citing concerns over water use, electricity demand, wildlife habitat and public access.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Conservation group The Wilderness Society on Monday called for a moratorium on artificial intelligence data centers on federal lands, citing concerns over water use, electricity demand, wildlife habitat and public access. The call comes as the Trump administration is considering permits for several data center developments on lands managed by the Bureau of Land Management, according to federal land records. US President Donald Trump has sought to expand a range of industries on public lands, including mining and oil and gas Trump has championed rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and data centers, describing them as critical to economic growth and technological competitiveness. But the industry has increasingly faced local opposition The Wilderness Society said public lands should remain focused on recreation, conservation and public access, and called for a pause before large-scale industrial development tied to AI is allowed on federally managed lands BLM officials did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The agency manages about a tenth of America's land base, primarily in Western states

item.title: Peso mexicano recupera terreno, pero se mantiene por encima de 18 por dólar
item.description: El peso mexicano avanzó el lunes por segunda jornada consecutiva, mientras los mercados centran su atención en las minutas de las reuniones más recientes de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed) y del Banco de México, que podrían ofrecer nuevas señales sobre la brecha monetaria entre ambos países.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano avanzó el lunes por segunda jornada consecutiva, mientras los mercados centran su atención en las minutas de las reuniones más recientes de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] de Estados Unidos (Fed) y del [USN:L6N45G177 TEXT:"Banco de México"], que podrían ofrecer nuevas señales sobre la brecha monetaria entre ambos países. La expectativa de un menor diferencial de tasas entre Estados Unidos y México ha presionado recientemente a la moneda, ante el temor de que disminuya el atractivo de las operaciones de [USN:L1N45L0OH TEXT:"carry trade"], que buscan aprovechar los mayores rendimientos de los activos locales y durante años han apuntalado al peso. * La divisa mexicana operaba en 18.0845 por dólar en la recta final de los negocios, con una apreciación de un 0.33% en su segunda sesión de ganancias. El jueves, llegó a debilitarse hasta [USN:L1N45N0ZE TEXT:"18.4330 unidades"], un nivel no visto desde noviembre de 2025. * El repunte de la moneda ocurrió en medio de un [USN:L6N45R11S TEXT:"fortalecimiento global del dólar"], a medida que el euro se hundió, y una caída de los [USN:L6N45R0XX TEXT:"precios del petróleo"], tras un incremento de las exportaciones de crudo desde Oriente Medio. * Las actas de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Fed"], previstas para el miércoles, llegarán después de que [USN:L6N45O0QK TEXT:"datos laborales"] de Estados Unidos divulgados el viernes redujeron las expectativas de otro aumento de tasas en octubre, tras el ajuste aplicado en septiembre. * En México, los operadores esperan para el jueves las minutas del [USN:L6N45G177 TEXT:"banco central"] y datos de [USN:L1N45Q009 TEXT:"inflación de septiembre"]. * De acuerdo con analistas técnicos de Monex Grupo Financiero, el mercado muestra señales de una menor presión compradora para el tipo de cambio. "Consideramos que podría entrar en una fase de consolidación lateral con sesgo bajista, en tanto se mantenga contenida la demanda por coberturas cambiarias y activos de refugio, principalmente en dólares", dijo la firma en un reporte. * La bolsa mexicana también cerró con ganancias por segunda jornada. El índice líder S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) subió 0.69%, a 64,975.08 puntos. * Los títulos del grupo aeroportuario GAP (GAPB.MX) lideraron las alzas, con un avance del 3.89%, a 379.01 pesos. Les siguieron los papeles de la gigante de telecomunicaciones América Móvil (AMXB.MX) que sumaron un 3.77%, a 20.09 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años ascendió tres puntos básicos, a un 9.54%. El de la tasa a 20 años retrocedió uno, a un 9.97%.

item.title: In road trip finale, Panthers aim to spoil Kings' home opener
item.description: Before the Florida Panthers get to feel the energy inside Amerant Bank Arena for the first time this season, they'll have to experience another team's home opener Tuesday night when they visit the Los Angeles Kings to conclude a season-opening four-game road trip.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Before the Florida Panthers get to feel the energy inside Amerant Bank Arena for the first time this season, they'll have to experience another team's home opener Tuesday night when they visit the Los Angeles Kings to conclude a season-opening four-game road trip. They opened the new campaign with a 1-0 overtime win against the Carolina Hurricanes on Sept. 29, then lost 4-3 in overtime to the Sharks in San Jose's season opener Thursday. Florida faced another young, fast team riled up for their first home game Sunday and again rallied late, pushing the Anaheim Ducks to overtime before losing 3-2. "Anytime you do three home openers in a row, it's obviously tough," Florida forward Carter Verhaeghe said. "It probably builds character for us and a good challenge for us, obviously. Other teams (are) going to come out, bring their best, and be skating and flying around." A lot has changed with the Panthers' roster since they headed out west. Team captain Aleksander Barkov suffered a leg injury against the Sharks and was placed on long-term injured reserve. The veteran center reportedly will miss 10 to 12 weeks. Brad Marchand recovered sooner than expected from offseason surgery, and the veteran forward took the ice against the Ducks, scoring a late 6-on-5 goal to send the game to overtime. "It was a bit of a rude awakening," Marchand said. "The speed of the game and the intensity definitely ramped up at times, but it was great to be back out there. It's going to take some time to get the timing and everything back, and conditioning back, but it was incredible being back out there and being part of the team again." Marchand played on a line with Brady Tkachuk and Sam Reinhart, feeling their potential as the game wore on, even if he felt a step slow. "We had a few looks, but it's tough for those guys," said Marchand, who had been out since March 6. "They know I'm just getting back, and it's been almost six months since I played a game and only been skating for a month now. "So, I kind of bring them down a little bit, just with my timing and the speed and all of that, so we're working through that together. But when I get back there, up to speed, we have great potential to be a really good line." The Kings are still looking for their first win after dropping their season opener 8-4 to the Colorado Avalanche in Denver on Wednesday and losing 5-4 in overtime in San Jose on Saturday. "It's tough," Kings coach Peter Laviolette said. "We're chasing the game a little bit. I thought that there was a ton of fight in the end (against San Jose). I really liked the way we played the overtime, and I hate the result. So, lots of things that we did well but, you know, we're still early in the season. We're working on things out there as well to get better at." Forward Quinton Byfield thought the Kings improved in preventing odd-man rushes against the Sharks, and they went 2-for-3 on the power play after going 0-for-4 against the Avalanche. "Our power play wasn't great the first game, so scoring two this game really kind of boosts it," Byfield said. --Field Level Media

item.title: Centalion acquires Haynesville natural gas assets from Silver Hill
item.description: Centalion Group said on Monday it acquired upstream and midstream natural gas assets in Texas and Louisiana's Haynesville region from Texas-based private shale company Silver Hill Energy Partners.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Centalion Group said on Monday it acquired upstream and midstream natural gas assets in Texas and Louisiana's Haynesville region from Texas-based private shale company Silver Hill Energy Partners. The commodities trader, formerly known as Gunvor, [USN:L1N45O096 TEXT:"rebranded"] as Centalion Group last week and said it planned to redomicile its corporate headquarters to Singapore from Cyprus. A Centalion spokesperson said the company's Haynesville platform, comprising the Post Oak and Silver Hill assets, has an enterprise value of about $2 billion. Reuters [USN:L1N44M0TQ TEXT:"reported"] in August that Centalion was in talks to acquire the Silver Hill assets in a deal valued at between $1.2 billion and $1.5 billion, citing sources familiar with the matter. The assets have current net natural gas production of about 300 million cubic feet per day (MMcfd) and the portfolio includes about 72,000 net acres in the Haynesville and Bossier development areas. "The rationale is for us to have a footprint in a basin that is the pivot point between domestic and export markets, allowing us to capture and create value from that optionality," the spokesperson added.

item.title: Queda no percentual de Flávio não indica erro; proporção muda conforme total de votos
item.description: Um vídeo que circula nas redes sociais alega que houve um problema na apuração da eleição presidencial neste domingo porque o candidato Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) teve uma redução no percentual apesar de ter somado mais votos do que seu principal adversário, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), entre duas atualizações da contagem.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo que circula nas redes sociais alega que houve um problema na apuração da eleição presidencial neste domingo porque o candidato Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) teve uma redução no percentual apesar de ter somado mais votos do que seu principal adversário, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), entre duas atualizações da contagem. No entanto, a variação ocorre porque o percentual nada mais é que a proporção de votos para cada candidato dentro do total de votos válidos, e estes números mudam ao longo da apuração. “O Flávio saiu de 12 milhões para 14 milhões e cacetada, foram 2 milhões de votos que ele ganhou, mas, mesmo assim, abaixou o percentual dele. Agora, o Lula estava com 10 milhões e foi para 11 milhões, foi 1 milhão só de votos. Como o Lula estava com 40,82% e subiu para 40,97%, e o Flávio ganhou mais de 2 milhões de votos e a porcentagem dele abaixou? Alguém explica o que aconteceu, porque eu não estou entendendo”, alega um influenciador no vídeo, que circula no Instagram . Enquanto fala, o homem mostra duas telas da transmissão da CNN Brasil deste domingo. Uma delas, das 18h23min , exibe os resultados com 21,96% das urnas apuradas: Flávio – 12.915.526 votos (51,07%) Lula – 10.324.360 (40,82%) Augusto Cury (Avante) – 743.675 (2,94%) Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) – 602.335 (2,38%) A outra, das 18h25min , mostra as parciais com 24,45% da totalização: Flávio – 14.344.471 (50,94%) Lula – 11.536.137 (40,97%) Cury – 827.940 (2,94%) Caiado – 668.442 (2,37%) Diferentemente do que diz o influenciador, Flávio não acumulou mais de 2 milhões de votos entre uma parcial e outra, mas 1,4 milhão de votos adicionais, contra 1,2 milhão acrescentados a Lula no mesmo intervalo. O percentual de cada candidato é recalculado com base no total de votos apurados em cada atualização, incluindo também os votos destinados aos outros concorrentes. Para manter ou ampliar os 51,07% das 18h23min, Flávio precisaria ter obtido uma proporção de votos superior a esse índice nas urnas adicionadas à apuração. Mas, como sua participação entre o novo total de votos foi menor, seu percentual recuou 0,13 ponto, para 50,94%, mesmo com o aumento do número absoluto. A Reuters entrou em contato com o influenciador que publicou o vídeo, mas não teve retorno até a publicação deste texto. VEREDICTO Enganoso. O percentual de Flávio Bolsonaro caiu porque a proporção de votos para ele dentro do total diminuiu entre as parciais mostradas no vídeo. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: US court warns more Jackson Walker cases could be tainted by relationship with judge
item.description: US law firm Jackson Walker is facing potential sanctions for not disclosing its work on ATM maker Diebold Nixdorf's 2023 bankruptcy, deepening the firm's potential fallout from a prior relationship between one of its lawyers and a Houston bankruptcy judge.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: US law firm Jackson Walker is facing potential sanctions for not disclosing its work on ATM maker Diebold Nixdorf's 2023 bankruptcy, deepening the firm's potential fallout from a prior relationship between one of its lawyers and a Houston bankruptcy judge. Chief US Bankruptcy Judge Eduardo Rodriguez in Houston ordered Jackson Walker on Friday to explain why it should not be sanctioned for failing to disclose its work in the Diebold case to the court or other authorities scrutinizing its fees in cases involving former US Bankruptcy Judge David Jones. Jones presided over Diebold's Chapter 11 case before he [USN:L4N3BL0B7 TEXT:"resigned"] in October 2023, after admitting he was romantically involved with a Jackson Walker partner. "Most troubling to the court is the unanswered question of how many other cases like this may be lurking on the dockets of the Southern District of Texas bankruptcy courts," Rodriguez said. Rodriguez said he was considering recommending the appointment of a special master to investigate other potentially undisclosed cases in which Jackson Walker appeared in cases before Jones. He ordered the law firm to submit a list of all such cases by October 15. A spokesperson for Jackson Walker declined to comment. The firm was co-counsel to Diebold in the Chapter 11 along with Jones Day. A spokesperson for Jones Day did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A Diebold spokesperson declined to comment. Jackson Walker is already mired in litigation over nearly three dozen past bankruptcy matters that Jones oversaw. The US Justice Department's bankruptcy watchdog, the Office of the US Trustee, is seeking to force the law firm to disgorge its fees in those cases. Jackson Walker [USN:L6N4400XF TEXT:"has been negotiating a $15 million settlement"] to end its fee dispute with the US Trustee, which is currently set for trial in January. The settlement is subject to court approval by US District Judge Alia Moses. A Justice Department spokesperson declined to comment but referred Reuters to its Friday status report in the case, in which the US Trustee said it faced "procedural impediments" in reaching a settlement with the law firm. Jones, based in Houston, once oversaw [USN:L1N3E92K8 TEXT:"the busiest bankruptcy docket in the country"]. Jackson Walker [USN:L1N3CE240 TEXT:"has said"] it was deceived into thinking its partner's relationship with Jones had ended in March 2020. The partner is no longer at the firm. Diebold, which sells ATMs and point-of-sale systems in more than 100 countries, filed for bankruptcy in June 2023, saying it had reached an agreement to reduce its overall debt by $2.1 billion. A hearing in the Diebold case is scheduled for October 22. Read more: [USN:L4N3BL0B7 TEXT:"Top US bankruptcy judge resigns amid ethics inquiry"] [USN:L6N4400XF TEXT:"Law firm Jackson Walker to pay $15 million in case tied to judge scandal"]

item.title: NFL suspends two officials for unprofessional conduct
item.description: The NFL on Monday suspended line judge Jeff Seeman two games and referee Adrian Hill one game for separate instances of professional conduct.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The NFL on Monday suspended line judge Jeff Seeman two games and referee Adrian Hill one game for separate instances of professional conduct. NFL vice president of officiating Ramon George issued the suspensions. Seeman made headlines Sunday when he was caught on video saying "f-- you" twice to Arizona tight Trey McBride while he worked the Cardinals' game at the New York Giants. McBride was complaining about the lack of a pass interference call late in the game, and the video caught the attention of NFL Players Association executive director JC Tretter. "This kind of behavior from an official towards a player is unacceptable," Tretter wrote on social media. "Players are consistently held accountable when the roles are reversed. We expect the NFL to hold officials to the same standard." Hill was officiating the Minnesota Vikings' home game against the Miami Dolphins when, on a play that was whistled dead for a penalty, Dolphins running back Ollie Gordon II blocked Vikings linebacker Eric Wilson into Hill, knocking him down. Hill took umbrage and was seen yelling at Wilson to go back to his team's huddle, though Wilson told reporters later that the situation was "funny" and Hill was "cool about it" after Wilson apologized. --Field Level Media

item.title: New York declares first US measles disaster emergency since 2025 surge
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a statewide disaster emergency on Monday over a measles outbreak, the first such declaration by a U.S. state since cases began surging in 2025.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Governor Kathy Hochul declared a statewide disaster emergency on Monday over a measles outbreak, the first such declaration by a U.S. state since cases began surging in 2025. The state also expanded the pool of health professionals allowed to administer measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccines as cases rise in rural communities. "No one should get seriously ill or die from a vaccine-preventable disease," Hochul said in a statement. New York has reported 108 measles cases this year through October 3, including 92 since July 15 in under-immunized rural communities across 18 counties, well above typical annual levels, according to the executive order. Seven of the cases are in New York City and 101 are elsewhere in the state, the governor's office said. Local health departments have administered more than 1,000 MMR doses in rural areas since July 15. Neighboring Pennsylvania is battling a fast-spreading outbreak, with 977 cases and five deaths as of October 2, mostly in rural counties that border New York, the order said. Pennsylvania health officials said on Monday the state's total had passed 1,000 cases, making it the largest state outbreak in more than three decades. The US is having its worst year for measles since 1991, with nearly 3,900 cases reported, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The order allows registered nurses to order tests for suspected measles and pharmacists to vaccinate children as young as two. It also requires all MMR vaccinations to be reported to state or New York City immunization registries within 72 hours, while waiving adults' consent for such reporting. Vaccination itself still requires the consent of the patient or a legal guardian. The emergency took effect on Monday and runs through November 4.

item.title: Trump diz que EUA ajudarão Rússia após morte em instituto de pesquisa sobre peste na Sibéria
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira, na Casa Branca, aos repórteres que os Estados Unidos ajudarão a Rússia após a morte de uma funcionária de laboratório em um instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira, na Casa Branca, aos repórteres que os Estados Unidos ajudarão a Rússia após a morte de uma funcionária de laboratório em um instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria. Trump disse aos repórteres, ao deixar a Casa Branca para uma viagem a Nebraska, que o surto é um “grande problema para a Rússia”. Uma funcionária de laboratório de um instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste na Sibéria adoeceu e morreu em circunstâncias não reveladas, levando as autoridades a colocarem dezenas de pessoas em quarentena. A morte gerou temores relacionados à saúde pública nas redes sociais, mas as autoridades russas afirmaram nesta segunda-feira que a situação estava sob controle. “Bem, detesto ver que eles estão passando por isso”, disse Trump. “É uma doença grave.” Ele disse que os EUA fariam o possível para ajudar a Rússia. Trump já afirmou que considera o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, alguém com quem pode trabalhar, apesar das tensões em torno da guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia. “Vamos ajudar”, disse Trump. “Qualquer um que tenha esse tipo de problema, estamos sempre dispostos a ajudar.”

item.title: Nasdaq atinge novo recorde de fechamento, com investidores de olho nos resultados financeiros
item.description: O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta segunda-feira, impulsionado pela Nvidia e pela Microsoft, enquanto os investidores se concentravam na queda nos preços do petróleo e aguardavam os relatórios de resultados trimestrais.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: O Nasdaq registrou um fechamento recorde nesta segunda-feira, impulsionado pela Nvidia e pela Microsoft, enquanto os investidores se concentravam na queda nos preços do petróleo e aguardavam os relatórios de resultados trimestrais. Foi o segundo dia de fortes ganhos do Nasdaq, depois que dados de emprego abaixo do esperado, divulgados na sexta-feira, atenuaram as expectativas de um aumento da taxa de juros pelo Federal Reserve em sua reunião de política monetária deste mês. O S&P 500 subiu e ficou cerca de 0,3% abaixo de seu recorde de fechamento de 13 de agosto. A Nvidia (NVDA.O) , gigante da inteligência artificial, subiu 2,1% e também atingiu um fechamento recorde, elevando seu valor de mercado para US$5,76 trilhões. A Microsoft (MSFT.O) subiu 1,5%, enquanto a Meta (META.O) e a Tesla (TSLA.O) registraram ganhos de cerca de 2% cada. Os preços do petróleo caíram após o aumento das exportações de petróleo bruto do Oriente Médio e o compromisso dos países do G7 de aumentar a oferta. “Com o calendário de dados econômicos fraco e os resultados financeiros a cerca de uma semana de distância, os investidores estão realmente à procura de qualquer coisa positiva em que se agarrar e, claramente, estão de olho nos preços mais baixos da energia”, disse Art Hogan, estrategista-chefe de mercado da B. Riley Wealth. BANCOS DÃO INÍCIO ÀS DIVULGAÇÕES DOS RESULTADOS DO TERCEIRO TRIMESTRE A temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre começa na próxima semana com os relatórios dos grandes bancos dos EUA. Analistas preveem, em média, que os lucros do S&P 500 tenham um salto de mais de 30% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, em grande parte graças às ações relacionadas à inteligência artificial, de acordo com dados da LSEG. Após os dados de emprego divulgados na sexta-feira, que mostraram que o crescimento do mercado de trabalho dos EUA desacelerou mais do que o esperado em setembro, os operadores estimam uma chance de 24% de um aumento da taxa de juros na reunião do Fed em outubro, ante 70% há uma semana, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. A PTC (PTC.O) disparou 33% depois que a francesa Schneider Electric (SCHN.PA) concordou em adquirir a empresa de software em uma transação totalmente em dinheiro no valor de US$22,6 bilhões. O S&P 500 subiu 0,66%, encerrando o pregão em 7.773,95 pontos. O Nasdaq teve alta de 1,05%, para 27.477,31 pontos, enquanto o Dow Jones Industrial Average subiu 0,18%, para 51.267,90 pontos. Dez dos 11 índices setoriais do S&P 500 subiram, liderados pelo setor de materiais (.SPLRCM) , com alta de 1,22%, seguido por um ganho de 1,14% no setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) . O otimismo em relação aos sólidos lucros corporativos ajudou as ações nos EUA a superarem seus rivais globais nos últimos seis meses, apesar do aumento dos rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro e dos preços mais altos do petróleo relacionados à guerra dos EUA com o Irã. A RXO (RXO.N) disparou mais de 22% depois que a empresa de logística C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW.O) concordou em comprar a corretora de transporte em uma transação com ações e dinheiro no valor de US$5,8 bilhões. A C.H. Robinson (CHRW.O) caiu quase 11%. A Cerebras Systems (CBRS.O) saltou 9% depois que o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, afirmou nas redes sociais que a projetista de chips é uma “parceira próxima” e que as empresas têm um “profundo compromisso em expandir as fronteiras da velocidade”.

item.title: US says foreign financial institutions doing business with Iran may be sanctioned without notice
item.description: The US Treasury Department said on Monday it was alerting foreign financial institutions that continue to do business with Iran or its financial sector that they may be sanctioned by Washington without advance notice.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US Treasury Department said on Monday it was alerting foreign financial institutions that continue to do business with Iran or its financial sector that they may be sanctioned by Washington without advance notice. DETAILS: "Foreign financial institutions continuing to transact with sanctioned Iranian financial institutions could be targeted at any time without advance notification and should take immediate action to terminate such activity and relationships," the Treasury Department said in its alert. Washington has attempted to further cut Iran's financial lifelines during the Iran war that began on February 28 when the US and Israel attacked Iran and Tehran responded with its own strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases. US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have [USN:L1N3ZR14Q TEXT:"killed thousands"] and [USN:L6N3ZY0Q0 TEXT:"displaced millions"]. Iran was already heavily sanctioned by the US before the war but Washington has warned other countries in recent weeks to cut their business ties with Iran or risk having key companies and entities cut off from the dollar-based financial system. Foreign financial institutions facilitating Iran's access to the global financial system, including by providing financial services to Iranian banks or their subsidiaries or branches in third countries, risk being sanctioned for operating in or supporting sanctioned sectors of Iran's economy, the Treasury Department alert said. They could also be subject to civil and criminal enforcement penalties should Iran-related transactions cause US financial institutions or other US persons to violate sanctions, the Treasury Department added. Prohibiting opening or maintaining of U.S. correspondent or payable-through accounts for a foreign financial institution are among the "strict conditions" Treasury warns could be imposed for engaging in sanctioned activities

item.title: Tate brothers used 'lover boy' model to exploit women, Britain says
item.description: Social media influencers Andrew and Tristan Tate used a "lover boy" model to lure women with the promise of romantic relationships before coercing them to create online pornography, British law enforcement said in court documents made public on Monday in the US.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: Social media influencers [USN:L6N451155 TEXT:"Andrew and Tristan Tate"] used a "lover boy" model to lure women with the promise of romantic relationships before coercing them to create online pornography, British law enforcement said in court documents made public on Monday in the US. In the most comprehensive description of the [USN:L6N44O0VS TEXT:"British criminal case"] against the brothers to date, a British detective said the basis of the prosecutors' case was that the brothers encouraged women to travel to their base in Romania with the promise of romantic relationships, before using violence and threats to manipulate them into creating porn. The Tate brothers, who have dual US and British citizenship, were arrested in Miami in July after Britain requested their extradition from the US. The brothers have not appeared in a British court to formally answer to the charges they face, which include rape and human trafficking, but they have denied wrongdoing. Joseph McBride, a lawyer for the Tate brothers, said the accusations could not be "meaningfully tested" because Britain had not disclosed the names of the accusers to the defense. "No American court should be asked to surrender a person to a foreign country on the word of secret accusers," McBride said in a statement. The arrests of Andrew Tate, 39, and Tristan Tate, 38, marked a new phase in the legal troubles for the former kickboxers, who have built a large online following promoting their views on masculinity and wealth. Andrew Tate has previously described himself as a misogynist. The British embassy in Washington last month sent the United States a series of documents in support of its extradition requests. Those documents included summaries of the cases against the brothers written by a detective with the Bedfordshire Police. According to the summary, Andrew Tate persuaded vulnerable women he had formed relationships with to relocate to Romania by telling them they could earn money by taking part in his webcam business. Once they arrived, the women became financially dependent on the Tate brothers, who often confiscated their passports, the summary read. "The prosecution case is that Andrew Tate and Tristan Tate used and threatened physical and sexual violence in order to maintain control and compliance," the summary read. The Tate brothers have been jailed in Miami since their arrests. US Magistrate Judge Lauren Louis on Thursday asked their lawyers to propose dates for their final extradition hearings, but no date has been set. The brothers have also been under investigation since 2022 in Romania on charges including human trafficking.

item.title: Trump afirma que EEUU ayudará a Rusia tras muerte de trabajador en instituto sobre la peste en Siberia
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el lunes que Estados Unidos ayudará a Rusia tras la muerte de un trabajador de laboratorio en un instituto de investigación sobre la peste en Siberia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el lunes que Estados Unidos ayudará a Rusia tras la muerte de un trabajador de laboratorio en un instituto de investigación sobre la peste en Siberia. Trump dijo a los periodistas al salir de la Casa Blanca para viajar a Nebraska que el brote supone un "gran problema para Rusia". Un trabajador de laboratorio de un instituto de investigación sobre la peste en Siberia enfermó y falleció en circunstancias no reveladas, lo que llevó a las autoridades a poner en cuarentena a decenas de personas. La muerte ha despertado temores por la salud pública en las redes sociales, pero las autoridades rusas afirmaron el lunes que la situación estaba bajo control. "Bueno, no me gusta nada que la tengan", dijo Trump. "Es una enfermedad muy dura". El mandatario dijo que Estados Unidos haría todo lo posible por ayudar a Rusia. Trump ha declarado que considera al presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, alguien con quien puede trabajar a pesar de la tensión por la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. "Les ayudaremos", dijo Trump. "Siempre estamos dispuestos a ayudar a cualquiera que tenga ese tipo de problema", agregó.

item.title: SpaceX quer gasoduto na Flórida para lançamentos em Cabo Canaveral
item.description: A SpaceX, de Elon Musk, , busca aprovação para construir um gasoduto na Flórida para fornecer combustível para seus foguetes lançados de Cabo Canaveral, mostrou um documento regulatório estadual de setembro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A SpaceX, de Elon Musk, (SPCX.O) , busca aprovação para construir um gasoduto na Flórida para fornecer combustível para seus foguetes lançados de Cabo Canaveral, mostrou um documento regulatório estadual de setembro. Uma subsidiária da SpaceX, a Coastal Connect Services (CCS), solicitou à Comissão de Serviços Públicos da Flórida a aprovação de uma tarifa para um novo gasoduto de transporte de gás natural de 32,4 milhas e 16 polegadas no condado de Brevard, onde fica Cabo Canaveral. A expectativa é que essa infraestrutura forneça gás natural, já que a SpaceX utiliza metano na forma líquida como propulsor em seus foguetes Starship. A SpaceX não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário da Reuters. A CCS propôs construir e operar instalações de gasodutos que levariam gás natural do gasoduto interestadual existente da Florida Gas Transmission (FGT) diretamente aos seus clientes, de acordo com o pedido. Na petição, a empresa afirmou que o gasoduto é crucial para o fornecimento seguro, oportuno e eficiente de gás natural, já que o atual abastecimento por caminhões e os gasodutos locais existentes não conseguem atender às crescentes necessidades da SpaceX em Cabo Canaveral. O gasoduto proposto seria semelhante a um gasoduto de 8 milhas que a SpaceX também solicitou para sua base de lançamento em Boca Chica, no sul do Texas. A SpaceX começou a contratar operadores de gás natural, buscando garantir um abastecimento de combustível confiável e econômico para os lançamentos da Starship na Flórida e no Texas, segundo a Bloomberg News, que foi a primeira a noticiar o desdobramento. A entrada da SpaceX no setor de infraestrutura de gás, normalmente domínio de empresas de energia e de gasodutos, ressalta sua estratégia de longa data de controlar o máximo possível de sua cadeia de suprimentos -- abordagem que exige grande investimento de capital e que ajudou a empresa a superar seus rivais no desenvolvimento de foguetes e espaçonaves.

item.title: Ole Miss RB Kewan Lacy expected to return vs. Vanderbilt
item.description: No. 9 Ole Miss anticipates having star running back Kewan Lacy back Saturday at Vanderbilt, but coach Pete Golding said Monday that the All-American will not carry a full workload.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: No. 9 Ole Miss anticipates having star running back Kewan Lacy back Saturday at Vanderbilt, but coach Pete Golding said Monday that the All-American will not carry a full workload. The Rebels (3-1, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) will use a rotation at running back rather than allow Lacy to handle the bulk of the carries. "That's going to be a constant rotation based on how (Lacy) is, and how healthy he is," Golding said. "But even coming back, he's not going to take the toll of 40 or 50 snaps, and all those things." Lacy suffered a shoulder injury in the Rebels' win over LSU on Sept. 19. He sat out Ole Miss' loss at Florida on Sept. 26 and then rested during last weekend's bye week. "Obviously (Lacy) rested all last week," Golding said. "Was good for a solid week, not practicing. Practiced (Sunday) night, came back. Did individual, did some team sessions. A lot of that was noncontact last week. Fully anticipate having him this week." With Lacy out, LSU transfer JT Lindsey and Michigan State transfer Makhi Frazier split the running back duties against Florida. In the season opener against Louisville, Lacy left with a thigh bruise but returned the next game and scored two rushing touchdowns against Charlotte. He has 191 rushing yards on 39 carries and four touchdowns in three games this season. A Doak Walker Award finalist last season, Lacy set single-season program records for rushing attempts (306), yards (1,567) and touchdowns (24). In 24 games over three seasons at Missouri (2024) and Ole Miss, he has rushed for 1,862 yards on 368 carries and scored 28 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック最高値、エヌビディアがけん引 企業決算に注目
item.description: ［５日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は続伸。エヌビディアとマイクロソフトの上昇が相場を押し上げ、ナスダック総合は終値ベ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック最高値、エヌビディアがけん引　企業決算に注目 5:17 配信

2013年8月、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

［５日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は続伸。エヌビディアとマイクロソフトの上昇が相場を押し上げ、ナスダック総合は終値ベースで最高値を更新した。原油価格の下落が材料視されたほか、来週始まる米企業の四半期決算発表にも注目が集まる。

ナスダックの大幅上昇は２営業日連続で、最高値更新は９月２２日以来。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種も上昇し、８月１３日に付けた終値での最高値まで約０．３％に迫った。

人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の主力銘柄エヌビディアは２．１％上昇し、終値での最高値を更新。時価総額は５兆７６００億ドルに達した。

マイクロソフトは１．５％高。メタ・プラットフォームズとテスラはそれぞれ約２％上昇した。

原油価格は中東からの輸出増加や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の備蓄放出表明を受けて下落した。

Ｂライリー・ウェルスのチーフマーケットストラテジスト、アート・ホーガン氏は「経済指標の発表が少なく、決算発表まで約１週間ある中、投資家は好材料を見つけようと探っており、明らかにエネルギー価格の下落に目を向けている」と述べた。

第３・四半期決算シーズンは来週、米銀大手を皮切りに始まる。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種のうち１０業種が上昇し、素材や通信サービスが好調だった。

個別銘柄ではソフトウエア企業ＰＴＣが３３％急伸。仏電機大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックが２２６億ドルの全額現金取引で買収することで合意した。

輸送仲介のＲＸＯも２２％超上昇。物流大手ＣＨロビンソン・ワールドワイドが株式と現金による５８億ドルでの買収で合意した。ＣＨロビンソンは１１％近く下落した。

半導体設計のセレブラス・システムズは９％高。オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）でセレブラスを「緊密なパートナー」と呼び、両社が「速度の限界を押し広げる取り組みで深く連携している」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．７対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１６８億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７３億株。

item.title: Mattel investor Ariel pushes for sale as turnaround stalls
item.description: A major Mattel shareholder urged the Barbie maker on Monday to explore a sale, saying progress in its performance and profitability had stalled, according to a letter seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A major Mattel (MAT.O) shareholder urged the Barbie maker on Monday to explore a sale, saying progress in its performance and profitability had stalled, according to a letter seen by Reuters. Ariel Investments, which holds a 5.4% stake in Mattel, said the company's shares remain significantly undervalued. "By our estimates, a strategic buyer would pay a significant premium to your current share price," Ariel Co-CEO John Rogers said in the letter to Mattel's board. The asset manager said Mattel's options included a "divestiture of significant assets, a merger and/or an outright sale of the company." Other toy companies were likely to find the Mattel portfolio attractive, Ariel said, as were entertainment companies and traditional private equity firms. Ariel's push comes as Mattel undergoes a [USN:L6N45M0SD TEXT:"leadership transition"]. Its boss Ynon Kreiz stepped down late last month, taking on the role of co-CEO at Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) . Mattel's board member Roger Lynch, who was the head of Vogue and the New Yorker owner Condé Nast, will take over as the toymaker's CEO next month. "Our board of directors and management team are committed to acting in the best interests of all shareholders and will consider the views expressed in Ariel Investments' letter, as well as the views of Mattel's other shareholders," Mattel said in an emailed response to Reuters. This is the second time this year that an investor has asked Mattel to consider strategic options. In May, Mattel investor Southeastern Asset Management called on the company [USN:L4N41L0QB TEXT:"to explore options"], including going private, or being acquired by rival Hasbro (HAS.O) or a large media company that would value Mattel's assets better than the public market. Last week, Mattel was [USN:L4N45N1E2 TEXT:"approached"] by Authentic Brands Group (AUTH.N) for a takeover, potentially valuing the toymaker at around $6 billion or more, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters. There is no guarantee that Mattel will be open to Authentic Brands' approach, and there is no formal sale process ongoing for the company, the source had said. Mattel's shares soared after the news. Despite that rally, the stock has lost a fifth of its value this year. The toymaker trades at a forward 12-month price-to-earnings ratio of 9.99, compared with an industry average of 14.03, according to LSEG data.

item.title: Petróleo recua com aumento de exportações do Oriente Médio e liberação de estoques
item.description: Os preços do petróleo caíram cerca de US$2 nesta segunda-feira, após o aumento das exportações da commodity do Oriente Médio e com o compromisso assumido pelo Grupo dos Sete de aumentar a oferta.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo caíram cerca de US$2 nesta segunda-feira, após o aumento das exportações da commodity do Oriente Médio e com o compromisso assumido pelo Grupo dos Sete de aumentar a oferta. Os contratos futuros do Brent fecharam em queda de US$1,93, ou 1,89%, a US$100,32 por barril, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos EUA registrou queda de US$1,68, ou 1,84%, para US$89,43. As exportações de petróleo do Oriente Médio ultrapassaram os níveis pré-guerra em quatro dos sete dias da última semana de setembro, segundo dados de embarque divulgados nesta segunda-feira, apesar dos ataques a navios que passavam pelo Estreito de Ormuz. "Embora os petroleiros ainda estejam em risco, a esperança é que, no fim das contas, mais petróleo chegue ao mercado", disse Andrew Lipow, presidente da Lipow Oil Associates. Enquanto isso, os países do G7 concordaram na sexta-feira em liberar 100 milhões de barris de diesel e petróleo das reservas de emergência e se comprometeram a abster-se de impor restrições à exportação de energia, após pressão do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump. No entanto, o analista da Raymond James, Pavel Molchanov, disse que o mercado permaneceu cético, pois não estava claro quanto do petróleo prometido no novo acordo viria dos volumes restantes da liberação de emergência de 400 milhões de barris coordenada pela Agência Internacional de Energia (AIE) e anunciada em março. O diretor executivo da AIE, Fatih Birol, disse na semana passada que os membros haviam liberado cerca de dois terços do acordo de 400 milhões de barris.

item.title: Soja sobe em Chicago com foco na qualidade da safra nos EUA e alta do real
item.description: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se valorizaram nesta segunda-feira, em uma recuperação técnica após três pregões de perdas, e à medida que chuvas recentes no Meio-Oeste geraram preocupações quanto à qualidade da safra.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de soja negociados na bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) se valorizaram nesta segunda-feira, em uma recuperação técnica após três pregões de perdas, e à medida que chuvas recentes no Meio-Oeste geraram preocupações quanto à qualidade da safra. Os preços mais firmes do óleo de soja e um real brasileiro mais forte em relação ao dólar também contribuíram para os ganhos em Chicago, segundo operadores. O movimento cambial pode desencorajar produtores no Brasil a vender, abrindo espaço para a soja dos EUA, precificada em Chicago. Nos EUA, a colheita da soja deve acelerar, já que o tempo deve permanecer predominantemente seco no Centro-Oeste dos EUA na próxima semana, segundo os meteorologistas. Chuvas isoladas são esperadas no leste do Centro-Oeste e no Delta na semana seguinte, afirmaram eles. No Brasil, maior fornecedor mundial de soja, os agricultores plantaram 7,3% da área prevista para a safra de soja 2026/27 até a última quinta-feira, em comparação com 9% no ano anterior, informou a AgRural. O contrato de soja para novembro fechou com alta de 2,50 centavos, a US$12,8075 por bushel. Para o milho, o tempo mais seco nos EUA pressionou os futuros, com contrato dezembro encerrando em baixa de 0,50 centavo, a US$4,9725 o bushel. O trigo fechou em alta de 9,25 centavos, a US$6,9225 por bushel, por preocupações com interrupções na oferta da região do Mar Negro e resultados de uma licitação de compra 683 mil toneladas pela Arábia Saudita, segundo analistas. (Reportagem de Karl Plume)

item.title: McKesson, CD&R near $5 billion-plus deal to buy Option Care, FT reports
item.description: Drug distributor McKesson and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice are nearing a deal to acquire infusion services provider Option Care Health in a transaction valued at more than $5 billion including debt, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: Drug distributor McKesson (MCK.N) and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice are nearing a deal to acquire infusion services provider Option Care Health in a transaction valued at more than $5 billion including debt, the Financial Times reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter. Option Care's shares rose 21% in extended trading following the report. The deal could be announced as soon as Tuesday, although talks could still fall apart, the report said. The possible acquisition would mark McKesson's latest deal as it seeks to expand its healthcare services footprint. In August, the company agreed to buy Precision Medicine Group for about [USN:L4N44M0SS TEXT:"$2.25 billion"] as part of a years-long effort to strengthen higher-growth businesses. Leerink Partners analyst Michael Cherny said the "strategic rationale" for a deal made sense, as it would expand McKesson's reach beyond physician offices into home and alternate-site care settings. Option Care provides infusion services that allow patients to receive intravenous medications at home or in other outpatient settings rather than in hospitals. McKesson had been [USN:L3N3V50X3 TEXT:"reshaping its portfolio"] by exiting non-core assets and investing in areas such as oncology and specialty care. Revenue in its oncology & multispecialty segment rose 33% in the latest reported quarter, helped by growth in specialty distribution and contributions from acquisitions. McKesson declined to comment, while CD&R and Option Care did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the report.

item.title: Cuba and US maintain 'channels of communication' but no negotiations, diplomat says
item.description: Cuba and the United States have maintained “channels of communication” but are not engaged in any formal negotiations, Havana’s top diplomat in Washington told Reuters, as the Trump administration pursues a pressure campaign against the Communist-ruled island.
item.dc:creator: Matt Spetalnick
item.content:encoded: Cuba and the United States have maintained “channels of communication” but are not engaged in any formal negotiations, Havana’s top diplomat in Washington told Reuters, as the Trump administration pursues a pressure campaign against the Communist-ruled island. In an interview on Monday, Lianys Torres Rivera, chargé d’affaires at the embassy in Washington, said Cuba remains open to a “respectful” dialogue but is “not naive” about President Donald Trump’s threats and has increased preparations to defend itself against any US military action. The latest US-Cuba diplomatic contacts have included meetings, phone calls and WhatsApp messages, but the two sides have made no progress toward a negotiating agenda or restarting official talks, she said. “What we have with the US is channels of communication,” Torres Rivera said. She declined to provide details on the timing, topics and participants. Her description of the communications appears to fall short of Trump’s assertion at the United Nations last month that Secretary of State Marco Rubio was “deep into negotiations” with Havana. Trump also called Cuba a [USN:L1N45E0LQ TEXT:""failed state”"] and predicted its government would fall. The Cuban delegation walked out in protest. A US State Department spokesperson said: "It does not come to our surprise that the Cuban regime is circulating this propaganda. In all reality, talks are ongoing and the regime has been unwilling thus far to agree to anything that would help the Cuban people, ultimately, threatening its total control.” Trump has openly stated that his goal is to fundamentally change Cuba's government. A US-imposed [USN:L1N45O0GT TEXT:"oil blockade"] has put the country under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and blackouts exacerbated by failing infrastructure. UN human rights experts have condemned the oil blockade as a violation of international law. Cuban Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez said at the end of June that talks initiated earlier this year with the US had stalled, and in early September that [USN:S0N44Z000 TEXT:"no talks were under way"] or planned. CUBA'S 'RED LINE' Torres Rivera said Cuba’s “red line” remains that Havana is unwilling to negotiate any changes in its political system, seeing Trump’s demands for the removal of the Cuban leadership as a violation of sovereignty. She rejected the Trump administration’s claims that Cuba was a threat to US national security or is interfering in US domestic affairs, and said Washington was using such accusations as a pretext to continue squeezing the island economically in what she called “collective punishment.” A US official, responding to Reuters questions, reiterated Trump's assertion that “we will not allow a haven for foreign adversaries to threaten America on our own doorstep.” The Trump administration tightened the embargo against Cuba last week, further restricting travel there by Americans and access to US banking for its private sector. Those measures, said Torres Rivera, contradict US insistence that it wants Cuba to [USN:L1N45I063 TEXT:"expand private enterprise"]. Facing US pressure, Cuba unveiled [USN:L1N42Q0N1 TEXT:"free-market reforms"] in June that, if fully implemented, would represent the biggest change to the island's socialist economy since former leader Fidel Castro took control in 1959. But Washington says the reforms do not go far enough and has also called for "free and fair" elections. Despite the gaps, Trump predicted late last month that the US and Cuba “will make a deal,” adding, ”I [USN:L1N45I041 TEXT:"don't think we'll need the military"].” But the Cuban government remains wary. “Cuba has always been preparing for an aggression from the US,” Torres Rivera said. “And we are increasing our capabilities now more than ever before … It is to defend ourselves.”

item.title: New Zealand National support at weakest level since 2020, poll finds
item.description: New Zealand's ruling National Party has fallen to 25.9% support, its weakest result since the 2020 election, while the opposition Greens climbed to 14.8%, an RNZ-Reid Research poll showed on Tuesday, adding pressure on Prime Minister Christopher Luxon a month before the general election.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New Zealand's ruling National Party has fallen to 25.9% support, its weakest result since the 2020 election, while the opposition Greens climbed to 14.8%, an RNZ-Reid Research poll showed on Tuesday, adding pressure on Prime Minister Christopher Luxon a month before the general election. Labour also slipped to 30.8%, while the smaller Opportunity Party polled 5.5%, just above the threshold needed to enter parliament without winning an electorate seat. If the poll results are repeated on the November 7 election day, the result would leave neither Luxon's National-led bloc nor a Labour-Greens-Te Pati Maori grouping with a majority in the 120-seat parliament, potentially giving Opportunity a pivotal role in coalition talks. Luxon has previously said that his National Party was unlikely to work with Opportunity because of its tax policies. New Zealand's electoral system favours coalitions, with the result still too close to call. The poll by 1News [USN:L4N45K0CQ TEXT:"Verian"] released last week suggested that Labour, the Greens, Te Pati Maori and the Opportunity Party could govern in a left-leaning coalition with 65 seats, against 59 for National, ACT and NZ First. The online poll of 1,000 eligible voters was conducted from September 24 to October 1 and had a margin of error of 3.1 percentage points.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ約1年5カ月ぶり安値、仏財政懸念が重し　ドル対円で小幅高 5:09 配信

２０１１年１月撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　５日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対し底堅く推移し、対円で小幅に上昇した。ユーロは対ドルで約１年５カ月ぶりの安値に下落。フランス国債が大幅に売られたことを受け、ユーロ圏で政府債務危機が再燃するとの懸念がユーロの売りにつながっている。

終盤の取引でドル／円 は０．１２％高の１５８．０４円。円安に対する日本政府当局者の度重なるけん制発言にもかかわらず、足元の円安進行に歯止めはかかっていない。

高市早苗首相は５日に行った臨時国会での所信表明演説で、経済成長の重要性を改めて訴えるとともに財政規律も重視する姿勢を示したほか、市場が想定外の動きを示した場合は「必要な対応を機動的に講じる」と述べ、政権発足以降に進んだ円安・金利上昇に対する配慮を前面に出した。

ユーロ／ドルは０．３６％安の１．１２１１ドル。一時は０．８％下落し、２０２５年５月以来の安値となる１．１１６０ドルを付けた。

フランスでは２０２７年に大統領選を控え政治的不透明感が高まっていることに加え、財政安定化への懸念が広がる中、国債に対する売り圧力が高まり、２日の取引で仏１０年国債利回りは５％に迫り、２００２年以来の高水準を付けた。この日の取引では買い戻しが入り、利回りは小幅に低下したものの、前週に急拡大した独仏国債利回り格差はなお高水準にとどまっている。

シルバー・ゴールド・ブル（トロント）の外国為替・貴金属リスク管理責任者エリック・ブレガー氏は「今週の外為市場ではフランス情勢が最大の材料になる」と指摘。この日の取引で、独仏国債利回り格差が２日に付けた１６０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）から１３５ｂｐ前後に縮小したことで、ユーロは朝方の安値から持ち直したとの見方を示した。

スペインのサンチェス首相がこの日、政府の主要な住宅関連政令が議会で否決されたことを受け、議会を解散して改めて国民に信を問うとして、１１月２９日に総選挙を実施すると発表したこともユーロの重荷になっている。

こうした中、ドルはインフレ圧力の根強さを示す経済指標を背景に主要通貨に対し底堅く推移。 主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２８％高の１０２．１９。一時は１０２．５３まで上昇し、２０２５年４月１０日以来の高水準を付けた。

米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）発表の９月の非製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は５４．９と、８月の５５．４から低下したものの、景況拡大の節目となる５０は上回ったほか、供給網の逼迫を背景に企業の投入価格は上昇。インフレが高止まりする可能性が示唆された。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は９月１５─１６日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりで、決定は全会一致だった。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、今月２７─２８のＦＯＭで追加利上げが決定される確率は２３．８％と、１週間前の７０．９％から大きく低下。ただ、年内最後となる１２月８─９日の会合での利上げが決定される確率は８８．１％と織り込まれている。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.90/157.94

始値 157.91

高値 158.29

安値 157.91

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1221/1.1225

始値 1.1197

高値 1.1225

安値 1.1187

item.title: Lucid's third-quarter deliveries miss estimates as it cuts output to run down inventory
item.description: Lucid Group's third-quarter deliveries fell short of Wall Street estimates on Monday, with the luxury EV maker reducing production from the prior quarter and selling vehicles from its existing inventory as part of a cost-cutting overhaul.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lucid Group's (LCID.O) third-quarter deliveries fell short of Wall Street estimates on Monday, with the luxury EV maker reducing production from the prior quarter and selling vehicles from its existing inventory as part of a cost-cutting overhaul. Here are some details: Lucid delivered 3,806 vehicles in the quarter ended September 30, below the average analyst estimate of 4,687, according to Visible Alpha data. It built 2,954 vehicles, compared with the 3,709 analysts had expected. Output fell 38% to 2,954 units from 4,774 vehicles in the second quarter after it eliminated a second shift at its AMP-1 plant in Arizona. Deliveries exceeded production by 852 vehicles as Lucid turned unsold cars into sales. This is part of a cost-saving initiative that targets $1.4 billion in cash flow improvements this year. The company said demand for its Gravity SUV "continued to regain momentum," but gave no figures. Lucid has delivered 10,852 vehicles so far this year. To meet analysts' full-year estimate of about 17,070, it would need to deliver roughly 6,200 in the fourth quarter, higher than its quarterly record of 5,345, set in the fourth quarter of 2025.

item.title: Trump says US will help Russia after Siberia plague institute death
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday at the White House told reporters that the United States will help Russia after a laboratory worker died at a plague research institute in Siberia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Monday at the White House told reporters that the United States will help Russia after a laboratory worker died at a plague research institute in Siberia. Trump told reporters as he left the White House for a trip to Nebraska that the outbreak is a "big problem for Russia." A laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia fell ill and died in undisclosed circumstances, prompting authorities to quarantine dozens of people. The death has sparked public health fears on social media, but Russian authorities said on Monday the situation was under control. "Well, I hate to see them having it," Trump said. "It's a rough disease." He said the US would do what it could to help Russia. Trump has said he considers Russian President Vladimir Putin someone whom he can work with despite tensions over Russia's war against Ukraine. "We'll help," Trump said. "Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we're always will to help."

item.description:
Nicole Jao
[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は約２ドル下落した。中東からの原油輸出が増加したほか、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が石油備蓄の協調放出を約束したことが背景。ただ、米国とイランの戦争に伴う供給混乱への懸念が根強く、下値は限られた。
清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８９％）安の１バレル＝１００．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．６８ドル（１．８４％）安の８９．４３ドルだった。
Ｇ７は２日、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。
また、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao

[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は約２ドル下落した。中東からの原油輸出が増加したほか、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が石油備蓄の協調放出を約束したことが背景。ただ、米国とイランの戦争に伴う供給混乱への懸念が根強く、下値は限られた。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８９％）安の１バレル＝１００．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．６８ドル（１．８４％）安の８９．４３ドルだった。

Ｇ７は２日、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。

また、 湾岸地域の産油国による原油輸出量が９月のほぼ半分の期間で戦争前の水準を上回ったことが、５日の海運データから明らかになった。

ただ、ＰＶＭオイル・アソシエーツのアナリスト、タマシュ・バルガ氏は「中東での停戦は依然として見通せない。サウジアラビアとイランが支援するフーシ派の戦闘再燃により、エネルギー施設や船舶への攻撃は続き、地政学的リスクプレミアムは高水準にとどまるだろう」との見方を示した。

ロンドンで開催された「エネルギー・インテリジェンス」会議に出席した石油業界の幹部らも、海上輸送の停滞や製油所の大幅減産、在庫の取り崩しにより、世界の原油価格は２０２７年以降も高止まりするとの見通しを示した。

item.title: Aprovação de Trump atinge nível recorde de baixa; hispânicos estão descontentes com os republicanos, diz Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, permanece em um nível recorde de baixa nos últimos dias, enquanto muitos eleitores hispânicos criticam seu desempenho no cargo e planejam rejeitar o Partido Republicano nas eleições de meio de mandato previstas para o próximo mês, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos divulgada nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, permanece em um nível recorde de baixa nos últimos dias, enquanto muitos eleitores hispânicos criticam seu desempenho no cargo e planejam rejeitar o Partido Republicano nas eleições de meio de mandato previstas para o próximo mês, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos divulgada nesta segunda-feira. Realizada ao longo de seis dias, a pesquisa mostrou que 32% dos norte-americanos aprovam a presidência de Trump, número inalterado em relação à rodada de setembro, que registrou o índice de aprovação do líder no nível mais baixo de sua carreira política. Os eleitores hispânicos ajudaram a impulsionar Trump à vitória na disputa presidencial de 2024, quando ele conquistou quase metade dos votos nesta fatia do eleitorado, em comparação com cerca de um terço na eleição de 2020. Mas o apoio ao presidente diminuiu nos últimos meses, à medida que os norte-americanos enfrentam a alta inflação provocada pela decisão de Trump de entrar em guerra com o Irã. Apenas 24% dos hispano-americanos aprovam o desempenho de Trump na Casa Branca, a menor porcentagem em qualquer um dos dois mandatos presidenciais de Trump. E, em um sinal de que a baixa popularidade de Trump está pesando fortemente sobre o Partido Republicano, apenas 26% dos eleitores hispânicos registrados planejam votar nos republicanos nas eleições de 3 de novembro, que determinarão o controle das duas Casas do Congresso durante os dois últimos anos do atual mandato de Trump. Cerca de 52% dos eleitores hispânicos pretendem votar nos democratas, o que representa aproximadamente o dobro do nível de apoio aos republicanos e a maior vantagem democrata desde que Trump assumiu o cargo. Realizada online e em todo o país, a pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos entrevistou 4.506 adultos norte-americanos e tem margem de erro de cerca de dois pontos percentuais.

item.title: Mariners' Cal Raleigh, Josh Naylor undergo procedures
item.description: Seattle Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh and infielder Josh Naylor underwent surgery Saturday and are expected to be fully recovered before spring training, the team announced Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seattle Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh and infielder Josh Naylor underwent surgery Saturday and are expected to be fully recovered before spring training, the team announced Monday. Raleigh, 29, had a debridement procedure on his left shoulder, while the 29-year-old Naylor underwent surgery on his right wrist. Following a historic 2025 season in which he hit a major league-leading 60 home runs, finished second in American League MVP voting and earned his first All-Star nod, Raleigh's production declined in 2026. In 126 games, he batted just .182 with 23 home runs and 69 RBIs. A right oblique strain sidelined him for a month in his first stint on the injured list. In parts of six seasons, all with the Mariners, Raleigh is a .218 hitter with 176 homers and 445 RBIs in 749 games. Naylor hit .261 with 10 home runs, 30 stolen bases and 57 RBIs in 152 games in 2026, his first full season with the Mariners. A first-round pick (No. 12 overall) of the Miami Marlins in 2015, Naylor is a .268 hitter with 114 home runs, 85 stolen bases and 492 RBIs in 897 games with the San Diego Padres (2019-20), Cleveland Guardians (2020-24), Arizona Diamondbacks (2025) and Mariners (2025-present). Naylor was an All-Star in 2024, when he set career highs with 31 home runs and 108 RBIs while batting .243. --Field Level Media

item.title: Buccaneers say S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) out 2-4 weeks
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield Jr. will miss two to four weeks after suffering a rib fracture, coach Todd Bowles said Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield Jr. will miss two to four weeks after suffering a rib fracture, coach Todd Bowles said Monday. Winfield, 28, suffered the injury late in Tampa Bay's 17-14 loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday that dropped the Bucs to 0-4. A two-time Pro Bowler (2021, 2025) and former first-team All-Pro (2023), Winfield has nine career interceptions, 13 forced fumbles, 18 sacks and 561 tackles in 89 career games (all starts). This is his seventh NFL season after being selected by Tampa Bay in the second round of the 2020 draft. Winfield had 24 tackles through the first four games of this season. The Buccaneers, already playing without starting quarterback Baker Mayfield, have a short week as they prepare to visit the Dallas Cowboys on Thursday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Popularidad de Trump cae a mínimo, latinos se muestran descontentos con republicanos: sondeo Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: El índice de aprobación de Donald Trump se mantuvo en mínimos históricos, ya que muchos votantes latinos han criticado duramente su gestión y tienen previsto dar la espalda al Partido Republicano en las elecciones legislativas del próximo mes, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos finalizada el lunes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El índice de aprobación de Donald Trump se mantuvo en mínimos históricos, ya que muchos votantes latinos han criticado duramente su gestión y tienen previsto dar la espalda al Partido Republicano en las elecciones legislativas del próximo mes, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos finalizada el lunes. La encuesta, de seis días, reveló que el 32% de los estadounidenses valoraba positivamente la presidencia de Trump, un dato que no ha variado respecto de un sondeo de Reuters/Ipsos de septiembre, en la que la valoración del líder se situó en el nivel más bajo de su carrera política. Los votantes latinos contribuyeron a impulsar a Trump hacia la victoria en las elecciones de 2024, cuando obtuvo casi la mitad de su voto, frente a aproximadamente un tercio en 2020. Sin embargo, el apoyo al presidente ha caído en los últimos meses, porque los estadounidenses se enfrentan a una alta inflación por la decisión de entrar en guerra con Irán. Solo el 24% de los latinos aprueba la actuación de Trump en la Casa Blanca, el porcentaje más bajo en cualquiera de sus dos mandatos. Y, en una señal de que la baja popularidad de Trump está pesando mucho sobre su partido, solo el 26% de los votantes latinos tiene previsto votar a los republicanos en las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, que determinarán el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso durante los dos últimos años del actual mandato del presidente. Alrededor del 52% de los votantes hispanos tiene previsto votar a los demócratas, lo que supone aproximadamente el doble del nivel de apoyo a los republicanos y la mayor ventaja demócrata desde que Trump asumió el cargo. La encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos, realizada en línea y a escala nacional, se llevó a cabo entre 4.506 adultos estadounidenses y tuvo un margen de error de aproximadamente dos puntos porcentuales.

item.title: Report: Chargers OT Rashawn Slater to miss time with ankle injury
item.description: Los Angeles Chargers left tackle Rashawn Slater is believed to have a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Chargers left tackle Rashawn Slater is believed to have a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday. Slater's injury is yet another blow for the Chargers' offensive line, which saw right tackle Joe Alt leave Sunday's 30-23 loss against the Seattle Seahawks with a neck injury while left guard Trevor Penning was being checked for a concussion. Those issues have come after new center Tyler Biadasz was lost for the season with a knee injury during training camp. The Chargers are off to an 0-4 start as quarterback Justin Herbert has completed 59.7% of his passes, which is 24th in the NFL. He has four touchdown passes to six interceptions and has been sacked 12 times, which is one off the NFL lead. Slater, 27, was named to the Pro Bowl in 2021 and 2024. He missed the 2025 campaign after tearing a patellar tendon during camp. He started each of the Chargers' first four games and has started in all 55 games he has played since he was a first-round draft pick by the Chargers out of Northwestern in 2021. --Field Level Media

item.title: Islamic State attack kills Iraqi policeman near Kirkuk
item.description: At least one Iraqi federal policeman was killed and four others wounded on Monday when Islamic State militants attacked a federal police site southwest of the oil-rich city of Kirkuk, two security sources told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least one Iraqi federal policeman was killed and four others wounded on Monday when Islamic State militants attacked a federal police site southwest of the oil-rich city of Kirkuk, two security sources told Reuters. The attackers used semi-automatic machine guns and sniper fire against the federal police regiment stationed near Hawija, about 70 km (43 miles) southwest of Kirkuk, the sources said. There was no immediate claim of responsibility. But security and army sources said Islamic State militants, who are still active in the area, were involved in the attack. The attack is the first reported assault by Islamic State militants on Iraqi security forces since US forces completed their [USN:L6N45L0KD TEXT:"withdrawal"] from Iraq on September 30, ending the military mission in the country. The United States had led a coalition that supported Iraqi forces in the fight against Islamic State, including efforts to prevent the militant group from regrouping. Washington said it would continue to provide targeted training and intelligence support after the withdrawal, while Iraqi forces would take full responsibility for the country’s security and for suppressing Islamic State remnants. Despite the defeat of Islamic State’s self-declared caliphate nearly a decade ago, the group retains [USN:L8N45K0OM TEXT:"sleeper cells"] in Iraq, Iraqi security officials told Reuters ahead of the US withdrawal. The withdrawal had raised concerns that a security vacuum could provide an opening for Islamic State to regain strength, with some officials warning that Iraqi forces would now have to contain the group without the coalition’s military presence.
