item.description: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比２．４０％（１６３７円４０銭）高の６万９９４６円...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は反発、米利上げ観測後退　一時7万円回復 10/5 16:03 配信

JPXのロゴ。9月28日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比２．４０％（１６３７円４０銭）高の６万９９４６円８６銭で取引を終えた。９月米雇用統計が予想を下回る結果となり、米利上げ観測が後退したことが好感され、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株を中心に買いが先行。日経平均は、戻りの節目として意識されていた８月１４日の戻り高値６万９６０８円２４銭を上回り、約３カ月ぶりに７万円を回復した。ただ、急な上昇への警戒感もあり、後場は高値圏で小動きになった。

注目された９月の米雇用統計は、非農業部門雇用者数は前月から伸びが鈍化、市場予想を下回り米国の連続利上げ懸念を後退させた。これを受けて上昇した米株を好感し、日経平均は朝方から上値に追いに弾みを加えた。

買い一巡後は、日銀連続利上げの警戒感があるほか、心理的な節目である７万円を一時回復したことで目標達成感が生じ、上値に対して慎重な動きとなった。前週からの上昇スピードが急なことも、伸び悩む要因となっている。

テクニカル面では日経平均の戻り高値更新が注目されたが、６月２２日の最高値７万２８３１円７３銭と８月１４日高値を結んだ右肩下がりの抵抗線を完全に突破したことで、さらなる上値が読めるようになってきた。

市場では「米エヌビディアが最高値を更新するなど、米国のＡＩ・半導体関連株物色の流れが波及する一方、物色対象が広がりが相場の強さを示している。ただ、原油高止まりや国内金利上昇懸念が、目先は上値を抑える要因になりそうだ」（野村証券ストラテジストの秋山渉氏）との声が聞かれた。

ＴＯＰＩＸは１．３３％高の４１４５．２２ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比１．３３％高の２１３７．３３ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆７５０９億００００万円だった。

東証３３業種では、値上がりは海運や鉱業、保険など１６業種、値下がりはその他製品や精密機器、医薬品など１７業種。

個別では、アドバンテストが連日の上場来高値更新となったほか、ディスコなども堅調だった。このほか、ソフトバンクグループが買われ、ファーストリテイリングも大幅上昇。半面、フジクラなど電線株の一角が小安い。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が上昇し、１．７６％高（１４．０１ポイント高）の８１２．２４ポイントだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが８６３銘柄（５５％）、値下がりは６３３銘柄（４０％）、変わらずは５６銘柄（３％）だった。

FAST

COPENHAGEN, Oct 5 : Norway's government said on Monday it plans to propose a temporary ban on the use of AI glasses in selected places, saying it is concerned people could be photographed, filmed or audio-recorded without their knowledge.  The proposal mirrors a broader global backlash against smart glasses equipped with cameras over privacy concerns • Ban could apply to places where the public regularly gather, such as parks, beaches, museums, shopping centres and public events, the government said in a statement • "I am worried that new, powerful technology is being introduced where people risk being photographed, filmed or audio-recorded without knowing it," Digitalisation and Public Governance Minister Torgeir Micaelsen said

• It could also apply to schools, playgrounds and youth clubs and to privacy-sensitive places such as doctors' offices, swimming pools and gyms with changing rooms • The government said it was not eyeing a total ban and that private use, and use where others are not at risk of being filmed without consent, would still be allowed • It said it would examine which technology the ban would cover, including whether it would apply to glasses with camera and audio recording, glasses with camera and AI functions or also other body-worn technology with camera, audio recording and/or AI • The minority government said it would present a bill to parliament as soon as possible, and would also set up an expert group to advise on permanent national regulation of body-worn technology

Source: Reuters

item.title: イスラエル行き旅客機の機長襲撃：30秒で1万6000フィート急降下を再現 無事着陸は「奇跡としか言いようがない」と専門家
item.description: イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦 （UAE）の格安航空フライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を刺した事件で
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
イスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたアラブ首長国連邦 （UAE）の格安航空フライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を刺した事件で 、この機体が約30秒間に1万6000フィート（4877メートル）急降下していたことが分かった。ロイターの依頼でフライトシミュレーターで降下を再現した専門家は、「垂直に近いジェットコースター」の様な状態だったとしている。その後、同機は機体を立て直して無事着陸した。

英南部に拠点を置くALPAシミュレーションのオーナーで航空インストラクターのアルベルト・パドゥアネリ氏によると、このような急激な降下は乗客や乗員だけでなく、ボーイング737MAX8の機体にも極めて大きな負荷をかけたと推測される。

当該機は9月30日、UAEのドバイからテルアビブに向かって飛行中に、副操縦士が機長を襲撃した後に急降下した。UAEの検事総長は3日、副操縦士が緊急用のおので機長を襲ったと明らかにし、この事件を「テロ攻撃」と位置付けた。

捜査事情を知る複数の関係者によると、副操縦士はオマーン国籍のハマム・アルハンマミ容疑者と特定された。 フライドバイは、事件を巡る状況について現在も捜査が続いているとして、それ以上のコメントはできないとした。オマーンも現時点で事件に関してコメントしていない。 シミュレーターの操縦席に座ったパドゥアネリ氏は、「30秒で1万6000フィートも降下すれば、とてつもなく垂直に近いジェットコースターに乗っているような感覚になるだろう」と説明。

同氏によると、航空機が突然急降下した場合には「体に負のG（重力加速度）がかかり」、シートベルトを着用していない乗客は「体が文字通り座席から浮き上がる」という。 パドゥアネリ氏がシミュレーターで今回の事態を再現したところ、急降下が始まる前に機体の自動操縦装置が解除され、その後機体は急激に加速したという。 事件では、乗客らが副操縦士を取り押さえた後に機体が立て直され、乗り合わせた交代要員のパイロット2人が操縦を引き継いで着陸させた。

トランプ米大統領は、事故の際に加わった極めて大きな力に耐えたボーイング機を称賛し、自身の交流サイト（SNS）に「精密かつ強固な構造設計の素晴らしさを示した」と投稿するとともに、737MAXが「設計上想定されていた範囲をはるかに超えるGと負荷に耐えることができた」と評価した。ボーイングはコメントの要請に回答しなかった。 航空機は大きな空力荷重に耐えられるよう設計・試験されている。ただパドゥアネリ氏によると、高速での急降下が長時間続けば、機体には極めて大きな負荷がかかってもおかしくない。 同氏は、「残念ながら機長は負傷したが、それ以外に誰もけがをせず、しかも機内に2人のパイロットがいたというのは、奇跡以外の何物でもない」と述べた。

一方アルハンマミ容疑者の経歴についても、徐々に詳細が明らかになってきた。ロイヤル・エア・モロッコはロイターに、アルハンマミ容疑者が2025年に同社で3カ月の訓練を受けていたと明らかにした。その後に同社への就職を希望したものの、採用されなかったという。

英国のバッキンガムシャー・ニュー大学によると、容疑者は同大学で航空管理に関する遠隔教育の課程を受講していたが、パイロット訓練は受けていなかった。 オーストラリア警察の報道担当者は4日、当局がアルハンマミ容疑者と「オーストラリアとのつながり」について捜査していることを明らかにした。容疑者はメルボルンの大学で学んでいたとされる。

item.title: 午後3時のドルは157円後半、ユーロの上下動がかく乱要因に
item.description:
Noriyuki Hirata
[東京 ５日 ロイター] -
...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午後3時のドルは157円後半、ユーロの上下動がかく乱要因に 10/5 15:41 配信

写真は１ドル紙幣。2021年11月撮影。REUTERS/Murad Sezer

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ５日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 157.83／157.87 1.1192／1.1193 176.66／176.67

午前９時現在 157.73／157.77 1.1254／1.1255 177.53／177.54

ＮＹ午後５時 157.83／157.88 1.1253／1.1254 177.61／177.68

午後３時のドルは、前週末ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べ、ややドル安／円高の１５７円後半で推移している。朝方に軟化したユーロを買い戻す動きに伴い、ドルが弱含んだ。午前の取引でも仲値後にユーロ／円が売られてドルが１５７円半ばにやや軟化する場面があり、フランスの財政懸念を背景としたユーロの不安定な値動きがかく乱要因となった。

実需筋の取引が集中しやすい五・十日に当たり、ドルは仲値にかけて輸入企業の買いが観測されて小じっかり推移したが、仲値後には軟化した。ユーロ／円が下げを強めたことが影響したとみられる。臨時国会がきょう召集され、高市早苗首相の所信表明が午後に予定されていたこともあって、円安をけん制するような発信への警戒感もくすぶった。

政府のリフレ姿勢の織り込みが円安を促してきた面があるが、日米首脳会談以降、片山さつき財務相らが市場の認識を修正するような発信をしており、首相からも関連する発言があるのではないかとの思惑が聞かれた。

その後もドルは上下動を繰り返した、午前の取引終盤にドルが急速に買われるとドル／円は切り返して１５８円を回復。午後３時前にはロンドン市場でユーロの買い戻しが入ったとみられ、ドルが弱含んだことでドル／円は再び１５７円後半に軟化した。

市場では「円は、ドルとユーロのバランスの中で翻弄された」（あおぞら銀行の諸我晃チーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト）との声が聞かれた。欧州の債券市場が落ち着くまでは「ユーロを経由してドル／円は不安定になりやすい」（諸我氏）との見方がある。

＜所信表明への思惑も＞

午後２時ごろから首相の所信表明演説が伝わった局面では、１５８円前半を推移していたドル／円は１５８円付近へとやや上値が重くなった。首相は「責任ある積極財政」について、経済成長の重要性を改めて訴えるとともに財政規律も重視する姿勢を示し、市場でも、財政への配慮がうかがえるとして、一部で円安の織り込みを修正する動きになったとの観測が聞かれた。

ただ、首相は消費税減税の財源について「市場の信認を得られるよう特例公債に頼らずに確保する」などと述べたが具体的な財源には引き続き言及せず、相場の反応は限定的にとどまった。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：有事のドル買いでも堅調維持したユーロ、「筋肉質」な通貨に化けるか＝唐鎌大輔氏 コラム：190円をうかがうユーロ円相場、円の構造的弱さ際立つ＝植野大作氏 アングル：ユーロ圏国債利回り差はリーマン破綻以来最小、「統合」まで距離 コラム：テック株懸念や欧米中銀トップ交代、ユーロは安全資産か コラム：ユーロ／円は180円試すか、日本円に構造的脆弱性＝植野大作氏 最終更新: 10/5(月) 15:41 ロイター

item.description: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 塩野義製薬は５日、米グループ会社Shionogi Inc.が米バイオ医薬品企業、Intr...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
塩野義製薬、米バイオ医薬品IntraBio買収へ　3155億円 10/5 15:39 配信

写真は塩野義製薬のロゴ。2023年2月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Androniki Christodoulou

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 塩野義製薬は５日、米グループ会社Shionogi Inc.が米バイオ医薬品企業、IntraBio（米テキサス州）を買収すると発表した。IntraBio社の発行済み株式をすべて取得し、完全子会社化する。取得価額は２０億米ドル（約３１５５億円）。規制当局の承認取得などを条件に２０２６年１１月ー１２月の取得を予定している。

買収により塩野義は、IntraBio社が保有するＡＱＮＥＵＲＳＡ（一般名：レバセチルロイシン）のグローバルでの全権利を取得する。ＡＱＮＥＵＲＳＡは、ニーマン・ピック病Ｃ型に伴う神経学的症状の治療薬として米国および欧州で承認を取得し、米国では販売が開始されている。今年９月には毛細血管拡張性運動失調症（Ａ－Ｔ）に対する世界初かつ唯一の治療薬として米食品医薬品局（ＦＤＡ）の追加承認を取得しており、欧州でも適応追加申請が実施されている。

IntraBioを子会社化することで、塩野義が感染症以外の重点領域として取り組んでいる希少疾患の事業基盤を拡充する。

２０２７年３月期の連結業績への影響は現在精査中としている。

TOKYO, Oct 5 : Japanese automaker Honda Motor said on Monday it has developed technology that can wirelessly charge electric vehicles, including large trucks, while being driven, and plans to test the technology on a Japanese highway. • Honda plans to test the technology along with construction firm Taisei and road builder Taisei Rotec in the financial year beginning in April 2027 or later, it said in a statement • The system, developed by Honda's research arm with the two firms, aims to transfer electricity wirelessly from charging units embedded in roads to vehicles in motion, which could lead to fewer charging stops • A Honda engineer declined to comment on the cost compared with a conventional high-speed charging network, saying economic viability would need to be assessed

item.description:
Sabrina Valle
[５日 ロイター] - フランスのエンジニアリング企業シュナイダーエレクトリックは５日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏シュナイダー、米ソフト企業ＰＴＣ買収合意を発表　226億ドル 10/5 15:36 配信

写真はシュナイダーのロゴ。2022年9月、フランス・ナントで撮影。REUTERS/Stephane Mahe

Sabrina Valle

[５日 ロイター] - フランスのエンジニアリング企業シュナイダーエレクトリックは５日、米ソフトウエア企業ＰＴＣを全額現金による取引で買収することに合意したと発表した。同社の株式価値は約２２６億ドルと評価され、４日に報じられた報道が事実であることが確認された。

１株当たり２０５ドルの買収提案はＰＴＣの企業価値を２３７億ドルと示唆しており、直近の終値に対して４２．３％のプレミアム。資金は自己資本と新規債券発行を組み合わせて調達され、取引は２０２７年第３・四半期に完了する見込み。

この買収により、シュナイダーはソフト分野への進出をさらに加速させることになる。同社は６月、ＡＩ（人工知能）ソフトと産業用データを提供する非上場企業コグナイト・ホールディングの買収に合意している。

item.title: ホンダ、インドの四輪開発コスト最大2割減・期間半減 タタと提携で＝関係者
item.description:
Aditi Shah Maki Shiraki
[ムンバイ／東京 ５日 ロイター] - ホンダがインド大手財閥タタ・グ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ホンダ、インドの四輪開発コスト最大2割減・期間半減　タタと提携で＝関係者 10/5 15:31 配信

写真はホンダのＳＵＶ「エレベイト」。2023年6月、インドのニューデリーで撮影。 REUTERS/Anushree Fadnavis

Aditi Shah　Maki Shiraki

[ムンバイ／東京 ５日 ロイター] - ホンダがインド大手財閥タタ・グループ傘下のタタ・テクノロジーズとの提携を通じ、現地向け四輪車開発のコスト削減と期間短縮を目指していることが分かった。電気自動車（ＥＶ）の開発中止や中国勢との競争激化で四輪車事業の収益低迷が続く中、ホンダは創業以来の自前主義を転換し、注力するインドで現地企業の力を取り入れてコスト競争力と開発スピードを高める。

事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。エンジニアリング会社のタタ・テクノロジーズに一部の車両開発を委託し、最大２０％の開発コスト削減と現在約５年かかっている開発期間の半減を見込んでいる。 関係者らによると、タタ・テクノロジーズによる開発は、インドで最も売れている小型スポーツ多目的車（ＳＵＶ）セグメントのモデルが第１弾となる見通しで、関係者１人によれば、中型ＳＵＶが第２弾となる。別の関係者の１人は、品質・販売・収益の面で成功すれば、ホンダがインドから輸出する機会にもつながると語った。

タタ・テクノロジーズは５月、日本の自動車メーカーの車両開発を受託したと発表。相手先の社名を明らかにしていなかった。関係者３人によると、委託したのはホンダだった。ホンダは全社を挙げてグローバルで四輪のコスト削減に取り組んでおり、ロイターは９月、２０３０年までに１兆５０００億円の原価低減を目指し、主要なサプライヤーにも調達部品のコスト削減を求めていると報じた。

ホンダの広報はロイターの取材に対し、タタ・テクノロジーズとの協業、具体的な内容についてコメントを控えた。その上で、価格に見合った価値を提供できる「十分な商品ラインアップを（インドで）展開できていない」と説明。現地の顧客ニーズに対応したインドの戦略車を最速で投入する競争力強化戦略の一環として「外部企業とさまざまな協業の可能性を常に検討している」とした。

タタ・テクノロジーズにもコメントを求めたが、回答を得られなかった。

関係者３人によると、タタに開発委託を決めるまでにホンダの日印チーム間で紆余曲折があったという。 日本側が品質と安全性を確保するため既存のサプライヤーを使うことを主張する一方、インド側はコスト削減と開発ペースを加速するために現地のサプライヤーの活用を訴えた。

ロイターは日印間の話し合いがどのくらい続いたかは特定できなかったが、関係者らによると、一部製品開発の期限に影響した。関係者の１人は、タタへの委託は２年ほど議論して最終決定に至ったと明らかにした。

タタ・テクノロジーズは、印自動車大手タタ・モーターズから分離したエンジニアリング会社。関係者らによると、現地サプライヤーとの幅広いネットワーク、現地市場のニーズに合った車両設計ができることなどをホンダは評価した。独ＢＭＷなどとの取引実績もプラスに働いたという。

関係者１人の話では、委託後もホンダが品質基準を満たすための工程を監督し、技術、コネクテッド機能、運転支援システムなどの領域も主導権を維持する。

ホンダ広報は、サプライヤーを巡る日印間の意見の相違について、「次世代開発に向けて日々議論を重ねているが、そうした事実はない」と否定した。ホンダ・インディアの広報は、製品開発は異なるチームの緊密な協力が必要で、協働的な議論を「意見の相違」と表現するのは正確ではないと回答した。

ホンダの三部敏宏社長は５月の戦略説明会で、「四輪のコスト競争力は不十分だった」と振り返り、「中国やインドなどのコスト競争力、業界標準品の活用など外部リソースを柔軟かつ戦略的に活用する」方針を表明。インドでの商品展開については、市場環境や顧客ニーズに「しっかりとマッチしたインドベストの性能要件を再定義」し、小型ＳＵＶと中型カテゴリーの戦略車を「社外を含む現地開発リソースを積極的に活用しながら」、２８年から投入するとしていた。

ホンダは、世界最大の自動車市場である中国で急速なＥＶシフトと中国勢との激しい価格競争にさらされ販売が苦戦している。一方、世界３位の市場規模のインドは今後も中間層の拡大が見込まれ、中国の不振を補いたいホンダにとって欠かせない。

ホンダのインドでの市場シェアは、ピークだった１０年以上前の７．３％から足元１．３％に低下している。２５年の販売実績ではマルチ・スズキが約４割と圧倒的な首位で、マヒンドラやタタ・モーターズが約１３％をそれぞれ握り、手ごろな価格で装備の充実した現地の競合他社に「後れを取っている」（関係者）。

(Aditi Shah、白木真紀　取材協力：Daniel Leussink　編集：David Dolan、Thomas Derpinghaus　日本語記事編集：久保信博)

item.title: ファーウェイ、クアルコムと特許契約 ５ＧやＡＩなど対象
item.description: ［５日 ロイター］ - 中国の華為技術（ファーウェイ）は５日、米クアルコムと人工知能（ＡＩ）、第５世代（５Ｇ）移動通信...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ファーウェイ、クアルコムと特許契約　５ＧやＡＩなど対象 10/5 15:27 配信

写真はファーウェイのロゴ。7月17日、中国・上海で撮影。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura

［５日　ロイター］ - 中国の華為技術（ファーウェイ）は５日、米クアルコムと人工知能（ＡＩ）、第５世代（５Ｇ）移動通信、コンピューティング、ネットワーク技術を対象とする複数年の包括的な特許ライセンス契約で合意したと発表した。

• ファーウェイによると、クアルコムとの契約には、ファーウェイが保有するコンピューティング、ＡＩ、ネットワーク関連の米国特許の一部をクアルコムが買い取ることが含まれる。

• ファーウェイにとって、５Ｇ技術を対象に含むクアルコムとの特許ライセンス契約は初めて。

• 今回の契約が完了すれば、特許ライセンス契約の総額は６９億ドルを超える見通し。

• ファーウェイの知的財産ライセンス事業は、これまでの多額の研究開発投資を反映し、２０２１年以降、収益を計上。

• 近年の研究開発費拡大は、１９年以降の米国の貿易規制により、先端半導体や重要なソフトウエアの購入が制限されているため。

• ファーウェイがクアルコムに初めてライセンス料を支払ったのは０１年。初のライセンス収入は１１年にモトローラから受け取った。

• ファーウェイは８月にＨＰとのライセンス契約を発表。

item.title: Exclusive-Cost pressures and deadlock force Honda to rework India strategy, sources say
item.description: MUMBAI/TOKYO, Oct 5 : Honda Motor aims to cut costs by as much as a fifth and halve development times under its new partnership in India with Tata Technologies, according to two people familiar with the matter, as pressure from rivals forces the Japanese automaker to rethink its go-it-alone approach.Reeling

item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-Cost pressures and deadlock force Honda to rework India strategy, sources say

FILE PHOTO: File Photo: Honda's new SUV Elevate is displayed during its world premiere, at an event in New Delhi, India, June 6, 2023. REUTERS/Anushree Fadnavis/File Photo/File Photo

FAST

MUMBAI/TOKYO, Oct 5 : Honda Motor aims to cut costs by as much as a fifth and halve development times under its new partnership in India with Tata Technologies, according to two people familiar with the matter, as pressure from rivals forces the Japanese automaker to rethink its go-it-alone approach. Reeling from electric vehicle (EV)-related losses that it expects to reach more than $12 billion, Honda is pivoting to gasoline-electric hybrids and slashing expenses. Last month, Reuters reported that it is seeking to cut more than $9 billion in costs over the next four years and has told suppliers to drastically reduce prices. In May, engineering firm Tata Technologies said it was selected to develop vehicles for a Japanese automaker. It declined to name the partner, but the two people and another person familiar with the matter said it was Honda. Under the outsourcing agreement, Tata Technologies will develop cars for the Indian market, while Honda expects to see up to 20 per cent in cost reductions and halve its development times from around five years at present, two people said.

Honda decided to bring in Tata Technologies after the automaker's Japanese and Indian managers failed to agree on which suppliers to use for upcoming vehicles in India, two of the people said. All three sources declined to be identified because the information has not been made public. The cost-cutting and development targets in India, as well as the internal deadlock over supplier strategy, are being reported for the first time. In a statement, Honda said it has not been able to offer a sufficient product line-up in India that allows customers "value for money." To that end, it was "redefining" its offerings in India and planned to introduce vehicles that strike a balance between quality and price, it said. It denied there were disagreements between the Japanese and Indian teams over supplier selection.  In a separate statement, Honda India said product development involved close collaboration between different teams, adding that it was inaccurate to characterise collaborative discussions as disagreements. Tata Technologies did not respond to a request for comment. STRATEGY DEADLOCK Japanese managers wanted to retain established suppliers to ensure quality and consistency, while Honda's team in India pushed for greater use of local suppliers to lower costs and speed up development in the world's third-largest car market, two of the people said.  Reuters could not determine how long the deadlock lasted but the disagreement was enough to delay work on some products, the two people said. The partnership had been under discussion for about two years before being finalised, one of them added. Tata Technologies, which was spun off from Indian automaker Tata Motors, was chosen because of its access to a broad network of local suppliers and because Honda managers believed it could design vehicles in line with consumer tastes and spending preferences, the person said.  Honda will oversee the process to ensure quality standards are met and will retain control over areas like technology, connectivity and driver-assistance systems, the person added. FAMOUS INDEPENDENCE Honda has long carried the imprint of its famously independent late founder, Soichiro Honda. It developed two of the world's best-selling cars, the Civic and the Accord, along with the most popular motorcycle of all time, the Super Cub.  Like other Japanese automakers, Honda faces the difficult balancing act of defending its legacy business in places like the US while developing new technologies to compete with Chinese firms elsewhere. India, a fast-growing market that remains closed to Chinese EV makers, has become more important.  But Honda's market share there has slumped to 1.3 per cent from a peak of 7.3 per cent more than a decade ago. Its portfolio has shrunk to four models and it is losing to affordable, feature-packed rivals like Tata Motors and Mahindra. It also has little to offer in the biggest and fastest-growing SUV segment. "Honda is already late and behind competitors," one of the people said. Honda President Toshihiro Mibe is under pressure to turn around the automaker, which recorded its first-ever annual loss in the last financial year. In May, Mibe said that while India was a "key focus" for Honda, the automaker had not always been successful there.  "We need to rebuild the business on an entirely different footing," he said. Previously, Honda adapted for India cars that were originally designed for Japan or other global markets. That resulted in it offering vehicles that were seen as over-engineered and pricey. The first vehicle under development with Tata Technologies is a small SUV that is less than 4 metres (13.1 feet) in length, a segment that accounts for a large portion of India's car market and where Honda has limited presence. It is targeted for launch in 2028, two of the people said. A second, mid-size SUV is expected to follow, with Honda later trying to revive its strength in sedans, one of them added. In its statement, Honda said it planned to launch vehicles in India in the sub-4-metre category and the larger midsize category from 2028 onwards. India is Honda's only major emerging market and it wants to make manufacturing and sourcing there more competitive. If the first product under the deal is successful in terms of quality, sales and profitability, it will open opportunities for Honda to export from India, one of the people said.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 先端半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区） は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ラピダス、日米など17企業と顧客の設計支援　早期納品向け協力 10/5 15:12 配信

写真はラピダスのロゴ。8月21日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 先端半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区） は５日、日米やインド、マレーシアなど設計関連企業１７社と「デザイン・ソリューション・アソシエート」を立ち上げると発表した。ラピダスの顧客に対し、各社の設計リソースや専門知見を提供し、半導体の設計から製造までの支援体制を強化する狙い。ラピダスは、来年後半に回路線幅２ナノメートル（ナノは１０億分の１）の先端半導体の量産開始を目指す。

先端半導体では半導体受託生産最大手の台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ） などが先行している。後発のラピダスは、顧客を設計段階から支援することで早期納品につなげ、対抗軸としたい考え。小池淳義社長は８月、ロイターとのインタビューで「一にも二にもスピードだ。製造期間の短縮が顧客にとっては一番の魅力になる」と強調している。

ラピダスには、日本企業や政府が出資している。今回の設計企業群では１７企業の協力を得て「顧客が早期に開発を開始できる設計エコシステム」の構築を図る。参加するのは大日本印刷や東芝傘下の東芝情報システム、米半導体設計大手シノプシス、インドのＩＴ（情報技術）サービス大手インフォシスなど。

Oct 5 : Deutsche Telekom said on Monday it expected to save around €2.5 billion ($2.8 billion) in indirect costs by 2030 compared to 2023, as the German telecommunications group expands its use of AI and automation. "AI detects peak traffic on the cellular network earlier, supports customer service representatives, and thus helps resolve issues immediately," Deutsche Telekom said in a statement. • In 2027, AI and automation are estimated to generate gross savings of around €1.1 billion outside the US compared to 2023 • The company intends to partly invest additional 2027 savings in Germany's digital infrastructure and fibre-optic network

item.title: Huawei agrees to a multi-year patent licensing deal with Qualcomm
item.description: China's Huawei Technologies (HWT.UL) said on Monday it had agreed a broad multi-year patent licence deal with Qualcomm covering artificial intelligence, 5G, computing and networking technologies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's Huawei Technologies (HWT.UL) said on Monday it had agreed a broad multi-year patent licence deal with Qualcomm (QCOM.O) covering artificial intelligence, 5G, computing and networking technologies. Here are some details: The agreement includes Qualcomm's purchase of certain Huawei US patents related to computing, AI and networking, Huawei said in a statement. It is Huawei's first patent licensing deal with Qualcomm that covers 5G technologies. Huawei said the deal is expected to push the total value of its patent licensing agreements to more than $6.9 billion once completed. The company said its intellectual property licensing business has generated positive revenue since 2021, reflecting years of heavy investment in research and development. Huawei ramped up R&D spending in recent years, as US trade restrictions since 2019 have limited its ability to buy advanced chips and crucial software. Huawei made its first licensing payment to Qualcomm in 2001, while it received its first licensing income in 2011 from Motorola. The Qualcomm agreement follows a licensing [USN:L6N44M0N7 TEXT:"deal"] with HP Inc (HPQ.N) announced by Huawei in August.

Leftist, nationalists set to win election for Bosnia’s tripartite presidency

Reuters

05 October, 2026 11:30 am IST

Follow Us :

By Branko Filipovic and Fedja Grulovic SARAJEVO/BANJA LUKA, Oct 4 (Reuters) – A Bosniak left-leaning moderate, a pro-Russian Serb nationalist and a Croatian nationalist are leading Sunday’s election for Bosnia’s inter-ethnic tripartite presidency, the election commission said early on Monday, based on ballots from 96.31% of polling stations.

The results were largely in line with expectations and with projections by the Poliwave tracking platform, although voter turnout was low at a combined 42.02% in Bosnia’s two entities, the Bosniak-Croat Federation and the Serb Republika Srpska. Voters also cast ballots for the national parliament, alongside regional races in the two entities.

Voter frustration has grown over an economic slowdown, the slow pace of EU entry talks and a lingering political crisis in which ethnically based dominant parties from the two entities have repeatedly stalled decisions by the weak central government that links them.

Show Full Article

Denis Becirovic, a Bosniak of the Social Democratic Party (SDP-BiH) and part of the current tripartite presidency, garnered 26.78% of votes in the Bosniak-Croat Federation, ahead of the candidate for the centre-right Muslim Party of Democratic Action (SDA). The two had been considered favourites in the election.

Also leading in the Bosniak-Croat Federation was newcomer Darijana Filipovic of the nationalist and pro-European Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ-BiH), with 13.89% of the vote.

In Republika Srpska, Zeljka Cvijanovic, an existing member of the tripartite presidency from the Serb and pro-Russian nationalist Alliance of Independent Social Democrats (SNSD), secured 55.41% of votes, the election commission said.

Voting continued in some polling stations after the 7 p.m. (1700 GMT) deadline on Sunday due to delays related to a new electronic balloting system, Bosnia’s Central Election Commission head Jovan Kalaba told reporters in Sarajevo.

The election commission redesigned ballots and introduced new biometric voter identification and electronic scanners, which it said were aimed at curbing voting fraud.

Speaking in Banja Luka, the largest Bosnian Serb city, Milorad Dodik, a separatist and pro-Russian leader of the SNSD who visited Moscow and met Russian President Vladimir Putin last week, said his party’s candidate Savo Minic won the most votes for president of the Republika Srpska entity.

“We have won the member of the (Bosnian) Presidency, and the president of the Republika Srpska. An unexpectedly high result,” Dodik said.

Since the Bosnian war ended in 1995 under the US-brokered Dayton peace accord, the country has been split along ethnic lines into two entities linked by the weak central government and tripartite presidency.

Bosnia, which has struggled to recover from the 1992-95 war, secured EU candidate status in December 2022 and approval to open accession negotiations in 2024. Actual talks have not started, however, because the domestic legislatures have yet to enact core requirements such as bolstering judicial oversight and passing anti-corruption laws.

Borjana Kristo, the deputy head of the Croat HDZ-BiH, said that overall progress could be made through dialogue after the elections.

“Bosnia must make progress solely on the principle of consensus, dialogue, and mutual respect,” she told party supporters, cautioning against rhetoric that would drag the country backwards.

Many voters in the country of 3.4 million people say they want to move beyond divisive rhetoric but its politics have become deadlocked.

The EU and Russia have been vying for influence over Bosnia, with the EU seeking to expand its membership across the Balkans while Russia wants to slow that process down and preserve its influence over the Republika Srpska.

The US has also sought to bolster its influence in Bosnia, pushing for a $1.5 billion pipeline project to import US liquefied natural gas. The EU has said, however, that the selection of the company for the project lacked competitive transparency, while Washington and Brussels have also clashed over the role of the High Representative, the international peace overseer for the country.

(Writing by Aleksandar Vasovic; reporting by Branko Filipovic in Sarajevo and Fedja Grulovic in Banja Luka; Editing by David Goodman, Emelia Sithole-Matarise, Edmund Klamann and Christian Schmollinger)

item.description:

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日銀版需給ギャップ、4―6月期はプラス0.55％ 利上げ継続をサポート 10/5 14:16 配信

写真は日銀本店。2024年3月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada

［東京　５日　ロイター］ - 日銀は５日、４―６月期の需給ギャップがプラス０．５５％になったと発表した。１―３月期のプラス０．３６％を上回り、２０２４年７―９月期以降、８四半期連続でプラスとなった。需要超の状況の持続は物価に上昇圧力が掛かっていることを示し、日銀の利上げ継続をサポートする要因になる。

需給ギャップは、日本経済の潜在的な供給力と実際の需要の差を示す。内訳は、資本投入ギャップがプラス０．３３％、労働投入ギャップがプラス０．２２％。

国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）から推計する内閣府に対し、日銀は生産設備の稼働率や失業率・労働参加率などから試算している。

併せて発表した潜在成長率はプラス０．８１％。２５年度下半期のプラス０．８０％を小幅に上回った。

item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 ５日 ロイター］ - 内閣府が５日公表した９月の消費動向調査によると、足...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
消費者態度指数9月は前月比0.1ポイント低下、1年後の物価上昇見通し拡大 10/5 14:12 配信

写真は6月16日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　５日　ロイター］ - 内閣府が５日公表した９月の消費動向調査によると、足元の景況感を示す消費者態度指数は前月比０．１ポイント低下の３５．４となり、５カ月ぶりにマイナスに転じた。基調判断は「持ち直しの動きがみられる」で据え置いた。

消費者態度指数を構成する４指標のうち、「収入の増え方」と「雇用環境」は改善したものの、「暮らし向き」と「耐久消費財の買い時判断」の悪化幅が大きかった。

１年後の物価見通しは、上昇するとの回答比率が９０．６と前月比１．６ポイント拡大し、２カ月ぶりに９０％を超えた。１年後の物価が２％以上上昇するとの回答比率が前月比で増えた。コメ以外の食料品の価格上昇が影響した可能性は推察できると内閣府ではみている。

２０２２年のウクライナ侵略以降の物価上昇により、物価上昇見通しの上昇と「暮らし向き」判断などへの影響が推察されるが、内閣府では、９月の消費者態度指数への物価の影響は明確に判断できないとしている。

item.description: [パリ ２日 ロイター] - 格付け会社ムーディーズ・レーティングスは２日、大統領選が近づく中、フランスの２０２７年...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏予算案成立「極めて不透明」、ムーディーズが政治分断警告 10/5 13:42 配信

10月1日の仏閣議後、2027年度予算案に関する書類を手にエリゼ宮を後にする閣僚。 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 格付け会社ムーディーズ・レーティングスは２日、大統領選が近づく中、フランスの２０２７年予算案成立の見通しは極めて不透明だとの見方を示した。選挙後も政治分断が続く公算が大きく、財政再建は引き続き困難とみている。

ムーディーズは２３日にフランスの格付け「Ａａ３」を見直す予定。現在の見通しは「ネガティブ」で、今後格付けが変更される場合、引き上げよりも引き下げの可能性が高いことを示している。

フランス政府は１日、財政赤字削減に向けて緊縮の色合いが濃い２０２７年度予算案を議会に提出した。

ムーディーズは「議会の政治分断にもかかわらず、フランスの諸機関に主要な政策課題に取り組む能力があるかどうかが、ネガティブ見通しの解消を判断する上での最大の評価要素となる」と指摘した。

item.title: 英新車販売、9月は前年比12％増 ＥＶと中国勢好調
item.description: [２日 ロイター] - 英自動車工業会（ＳＭＭＴ）が２日発表した９月の新車販売台数は、前年同月比１２％増の３５万０５１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英新車販売、9月は前年比12％増　ＥＶと中国勢好調 10/5 12:46 配信

イギリスのチェシャーにある自動車販売店で2020年10月5日撮影　 REUTERS/Jason Cairnduff

[２日 ロイター] - 英自動車工業会（ＳＭＭＴ）が２日発表した９月の新車販売台数は、前年同月比１２％増の３５万０５１８台となり、同月として２０１７年以来の最高水準を記録した。電気自動車（ＥＶ）の旺盛な需要に支えられた。

中東紛争に起因する世界的な石油ショックを背景とする燃料費の高騰で、ＥＶが勢いを増しており、９月のバッテリー式電気自動車（ＢＥＶ）の登録台数は前年同月比３６％増の９万９１９９台となり、市場シェアは２８．３％に上った。

対照的に、ガソリン車の登録台数は同６．７％、ハイブリッド車（ＨＥＶ）は同４．２％、それぞれ減少した。

ディーゼル車の９月の登録台数は同１１．５％増加したが、１－９月は前年同期比で７％減少し、今年の市場シェアは約４．５％に縮小している。１－９月の市場シェアでは、ガソリン車が依然として４１．５％を占めた。

ブランド別では、中国の奇瑞汽車のＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「ジェイクー７」が最も売れたモデルだった。ＢＥＶでは中国の比亜迪（ＢＹＤ）のＳＵＶ「シーライオン７」が、米ＥＶ大手テスラのセダン「モデル３」とＳＵＶ「モデルＹ」に続き３位だった。

年初来で見るとＢＥＶの販売台数は全体の２６．２％にとどまり、２０２６年に義務付けられている３３％を大幅に下回るだけでなく、前年の目標だった２８％にも及ばない。

item.description: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 大和証券グループ本社傘下の大和証券は５日、外部委託先のサーバーへの不正アクセスにより、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
大和証、11万人分の顧客情報漏洩の可能性　外部委託先に不正アクセス 10/5 12:44 配信

大和証券グループの本社で2017年1月30日撮影 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 大和証券グループ本社傘下の大和証券は５日、外部委託先のサーバーへの不正アクセスにより、約１１万人分の顧客情報が漏洩した可能性があると発表した。漏洩の可能性がある情報は氏名、メールアドレス、口座番号などで、個人を特定できない問い合わせなどの情報を含めると約２２万件に上る。

不正アクセスは２日午後８時３３分ごろから３日午前８時０１分ごろにかけて、大和証券が問い合わせ管理サービスの提供を委託するシステム会社、スカラコミュニケーションズで発生した。大和証券は３日にスカラコミュニケーションズから報告を受けた。スカラコミュニケーションズは緊急のセキュリティー強化を実施済みで、現時点で追加の不正アクセスや情報漏洩は確認されていない。大和証券の自社システムへの不正アクセスも確認されていない。

漏洩した可能性がある情報だけでは証券口座へのアクセスや取引はできず、現時点でこの件に起因する不正取引は確認されていない。また、情報のインターネット上への公開・拡散は現時点で確認されていない。

item.title: 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル
item.description:
Stephen Eisenhammer
[ロンドン ３日 ロイター] - 産業革命以降、人工知能（ＡＩ）ほど巨額の資金...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル 10/5 12:37 配信

写真は「ＡＩ（人工知能）」の文字が書かれた看板。2023年6月、北京市内で撮影。REUTERS/Florence Lo

Stephen Eisenhammer

[ロンドン ３日 ロイター] - 産業革命以降、人工知能（ＡＩ）ほど巨額の資金を呼び込んでいる新技術はかつて存在しない。もはや鉄道やインターネットが技術革命を巻き起こした時代の投資額さえしのごうとしている。

会計事務所プライスウォーターハウスクーパース（ＰｗＣ）の試算に基づくと、世界のデータセンターへの２０５０年までの累積投資額は３０兆ドル超と、米国債の発行残高にほぼ匹敵する規模に達する可能性がある。ＰｗＣは、インフレを考慮しても、鉄道ブームやＩＴバブルの際の投資額を「はるかに上回る」と指摘している。

ＡＩ開発競争をリードする企業の一つ、アンソロピックも今後数年間で５１８０億ドルを投じる計画だ。ロイターが確認した新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の目論見書によると、その額は同社の２５年売上高の１００倍を超える。

ＡＩを支持する人々は、この技術が蒸気機関の登場と、それがもたらした工業化をも上回る変革を社会にもたらすと主張する。

目まいがするような成長予測やＡＩ企業による巨額の投資、そして極めて高い企業評価額の背後にあるのは、ＡＩによって経済全体の生産性が大幅に向上し、将来巨額の利益が生まれるとの前提だ。しかしエコノミストらによれば、そうした期待が実現可能なことを裏付ける証拠は今のところ乏しく、確かな歴史的前例もない。

＜依然不確実な生産性向上＞

ＪＰモルガンは８月、ＡＩ開発競争を主導する米国について、経済全体に及ぶ生産性向上は「依然として見えてこない」と描写し、ＡＩ関連企業の現在の評価額が持続可能なのか疑問を呈した。コンサルティング会社ベイン・アンド・カンパニーが９月に発表した調査も、既存市場における生産性向上だけでは現在の巨額投資を正当化できず、資金面のギャップを埋めるには「全く新しい市場が生まれなければならない」と分析した。

そうした市場として想定されるのは、ＡＩが制御するロボットの活用から、電池や半導体向けの新素材開発まで幅広い。グーグル、アマゾン・ドット・コム、マイクロソフトといった世界各地でＡＩインフラを展開する米国の巨大クラウド事業者（ハイパースケーラー）をはじめとするＡＩ関連企業は、こうした設備投資を賄うため、今後５年間で４兆２０００億ドルを超える新たな売上高を生み出す必要がある、というのがベインの試算結果だ。

同社は「問題は、その投資を回収できるだけのＡＩアプリケーションが間に合うように登場するかどうかだ」と指摘した。

過去の技術革命によって移動時間が数日から数時間に短縮され、インターネットによって瞬時に世界がつながったように、ＡＩがオフィスでの仕事から研究所での活動まであらゆるものを変革する可能性については、ほとんど疑いがない。

一方、投資の採算を確保するための計算や、借金を返済しなければならない期限はそう簡単には変わらない。このためエコノミストは、投資ブームの盛衰を超えてＡＩ投資が世界経済にどのような影響を与えるのかを見極めようとしている。

ＪＰモルガンは「歴史を振り返ると、技術革新に伴うブームはインフラへの巨額投資が十分な収益を生み出せなくなった時に終わることが多い」と記した。

ＡＩ革命を支える半導体を供給するエヌビディアを例に取ると、同社の現在の企業価値を正当化するには、ＪＰモルガンの見積もりでは米国の生産性が今後１０年間、毎年３－５％のペースで向上する必要がある。これは米議会予算局（ＣＢＯ）が同期間について想定する年間１．７５％という生産性上昇率を大幅に上回る。

米コロンビア大経営大学院の経済学者スティン・バン・ニューウェルバーグ氏が計算したところ、世界のＡＩ投資の約４分の３を占めるとの推計もある米国だけを見ても、その投資額は２５年から３２年までに最大約９兆ドルに達し、毎年米国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の３．２％に相当する額をＡＩに投じることになる。

さらに同氏によれば、投資額に対して１０％のリターンを３２年時点で得るには、米ＡＩ産業は年間約３兆５５００億ドルの売上高を生み出さなければならないが、現在の売上高はそのごく一部にとどまる。

ＡＩインフラ投資に使われている資金の多くが、借り入れによって投資額を膨らませるレバレッジを活用していることもリスクとなる。同氏は１０月に改訂した学会向け論文で「需要の比較的小幅な悪化や計画の遅延、資産価値の下落であっても、それによってはるかに大きな損失が生じる恐れがある」と警告した。

＜インフラが残れば問題なし＞

それでも、膨大な投資額やそれに見合う収益を稼ぎ出すための目まいがするほど高いハードルを示す数字を前にしても、米国のＡＩ業界のトップたちが未来について語る熱気は冷めていない。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、ＡＩがもたらす未来について「人知を超えた美しさを持つもの」になり得ると明言。オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマンＣＥＯも、ＡＩモデルが自ら改善する方法を学び、科学技術上の発見を加速させるようになれば「新たな驚異が生まれる速度は途方もないものになる」と語っている。

グーグル・ディープマインドのジャスジート・セコン最高戦略責任者は８月、カリフォルニア大バークレー校で開かれた会議で、このようなＡＩによる自己学習、いわゆる「再帰的自己改善」が「投資仮説の重要な部分」を占めていると説明した。これが実現すれば、過去に例のない規模の生産性向上につながる可能性があるとの見方を示す。

その半面、再帰的自己改善によってＡＩの能力が飛躍的に向上する可能性があることから、人類の存続そのものを脅かしかねないとの懸念も生じている。

いずれにしても、技術自体が急速に進歩したとしても、生産性の向上が企業の財務上求められる時間軸に間に合うとは限らない。

英ケンブリッジ大の経済学者ダイアン・コイル氏によれば、過去の革命的な技術の場合、生産性への効果が経済全体に波及するまで通常１０－５０年程度かかっている。

そうした中でアンソロピックの経済分析チームは、ＡＩによって３０年の経済成長率がどこまで押し上げられるのか、複数のシナリオをモデル化。ＡＩが存在しない場合の基礎的な成長率を年２％とすると、ＡＩの影響が限定的なシナリオでは２．４％、大きな影響をもたらすシナリオでは５．４％、そして極端なシナリオでは１５．４％の成長になると試算した。成長率が高くなるほど失われる雇用も増えるとしているものの、各シナリオが実現する確率については示していない。

アモデイ氏は昨年、今後５年間でＡＩによってホワイトカラーの初級職の半数が失われる可能性があると予測した。ただ現時点では、その影響はむしろ、オフィスワークを求める若者などが仕事を見つけにくくなるという形に限定されている可能性があると一部の研究者は指摘する。

米国と英国の研究では、ＡＩが得意とする業務を担うホワイトカラー職で若手の採用が鈍化していることが示されているとはいえ、雇用全体は引き続き堅調だ。米スタンフォード大の研究者らが８月に発表した分析によると、会計士やパラリーガルなどＡＩの影響を受けやすい業種で働く２２－２５歳の雇用は、清掃員や建設作業員などＡＩによる代替が難しい仕事と比べて１９％少なかった。

もっとも、ＡＩ企業を取り巻く現在の数字が示唆するほど早く変革が訪れなかったとしても、ＡＩへの巨額投資によって整備されたインフラ本体は残り、将来的に実体経済へ恩恵をもたらしてもおかしくない。

１８７３年恐慌で鉄道王たちが相次いで破産した後も列車は走り続け、１９９０年代末のＩＴバブルが崩壊してもインターネットがなくなることはなかった。同じように、もし現在のＡＩ投資ブームが行き過ぎだったとしても、そこで築かれたデータセンターや計算資源などの基盤は、その後も社会に残る可能性がある。

コイル氏は「この問題を理解しようとする時、歴史は私たちの味方になる。将来、生産性向上の効果を支えるために必要なインフラがきちんと残るのであれば、それで問題はない」と言い切った。

item.title: US accuses California woman of spying for China, surveilling Taiwan leader's son
item.description: The 34-year-old woman was arrested before a planned departure to China.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

US accuses California woman of spying for China, surveilling Taiwan leader's son

The 34-year-old woman was arrested before a planned departure to China.

A California woman, Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, is taken by the FBI after they arrested her and the US authorities accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te at the behest of Chinese officials, in Los Angeles, California, US, Oc 4, 2026. (Image: Reuters/Bill Essayli, First Assistant US Attorney for the Central District of California/X)

05 Oct 2026 11:27AM (Updated: 05 Oct 2026 11:44AM)

FAST

WASHINGTON: US authorities arrested a California woman on Sunday (Oct 4) and accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's president at the behest of Chinese officials, the FBI said. The FBI arrested Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, at Los Angeles International Airport on Sunday before her planned departure to China, the agency said in a statement. Authorities charged Zhang, 34, of Irvine, California, with acting as an unregistered foreign agent. Zhang surveilled a son of Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te, the FBI said. The agency did not directly name Zhang's alleged target, but later shared a New York Post report identifying him as Lai Ting-yu, a US resident. The Justice Department said Zhang travelled to Seattle in 2025 at the direction of Chinese officials and subsequently sent them photos, video and license plate information of the Taiwanese leader's son and his family.

Zhang used tradecraft to avoid detection and never notified Washington that she was acting for a foreign government, Bill Essayli, the first assistant US attorney for the Central District of California, said in a statement.

A California woman, Wanying Zhang, also known as Heather, who was arrested by the FBI and the US authorities accused her of spying on a son of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te at the behest of Chinese officials (Photo: Reuters/Bill Essayli, First Assistant US Attorney for the Central District of California/X)

The Chinese embassy in Washington and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States did not immediately respond to a request for comment. It was not immediately clear whether Zhang has a defence attorney. She will appear on Monday in a Los Angeles federal court, Essayli said. Lai and his Democratic Progressive Party champion Taiwan's separate identity from China, a position that frequently angers Beijing, which views the island as Chinese territory. Washington does not have formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan, but the United States is the island's most important international backer and weapons supplier.

item.title: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon to testify at NYC hearing on AI
item.description: Coxon will appear at request of Council Speaker Julie Menin, who has urged AI whistleblowers to testify as city lawmakers weigh a package of bills aimed at establishing safeguards around technology ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Nacha Cattan and Laura Nahmias Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who warned that artificial intelligence could become too powerful for humans to control, will testify Monday at a New York City Council hearing alongside representatives of some of the world’s biggest AI companies.  Coxon will appear at the request of Council Speaker Julie Menin, who has urged AI whistleblowers to testify as city lawmakers weigh a package of bills aimed at establishing safeguards around the technology, according to people familiar with the matter.  Coxon quit Anthropic last month and issued a stark warning about the race to develop increasingly powerful AI, accusing his former employer and OpenAI of “gambling with our lives.” He confirmed he plans to testify on Monday. The hearing will put some of the industry’s most vocal critics in the same room as representatives of Anthropic, OpenAI, Alphabet Inc.’s Google and Meta Platforms Inc.  Former Google DeepMind researcher Alex Turner and Daniel Kokotajlo, executive director of the AI Futures Project and a former OpenAI researcher, are also expected to testify, according to one of the people. The four major AI companies will send policy and safety officials, the person said.  Turner confirmed he plans to attend the hearing. A spokesperson for Google declined to comment. Kokotajlo and representatives of the other companies didn’t respond to requests for comment. The hearing is part of an effort by New York officials to play a larger role in regulating an industry that has expanded rapidly in the city even as much of AI regulation remains the province of federal and state governments. One proposal before the council, sponsored by Menin, would give whistleblowers a portion of fines or penalties recovered from AI companies following reported violations. Other legislation under consideration would allow people harmed by AI systems to sue developers under certain circumstances and require third-party validation of some systems before they can be deployed in the city. OpenAI, Anthropic and Google agreed to appear after Menin’s office warned that they could be subpoenaed, while Meta had committed to attending earlier, Bloomberg News previously reported. The Council subpoenaed SpaceX’s artificial intelligence unit after it failed to respond to requests to appear.

item.description: [パリ ２日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って世論調査で首位を走る極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏大統領選候補のルペン氏、「黄金律」で財政赤字削減を約束 10/5 12:21 配信

フランス北部で９月１３日、演説を行うルペン氏　 REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 来年のフランス大統領選挙を巡って世論調査で首位を走る極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は２日、財政を健全な軌道に戻すために拘束力のある予算ルールの導入計画を明らかにした。

投資家は当選する人物が誰であれ財政赤字を抑制できるか疑っており、フランス資産への投資を縮小している。

仏紙ロピニオンに寄稿したルペン氏は、自身が提案した「黄金律（ゴールデンルール）」を国民投票にかけると宣言。これはドイツの「債務ブレーキ」と同様、例外を厳格に限定し、議会を年次予算法案に拘束するもの。

このルールでは、財政赤字を毎年国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の少なくとも０．５％ポイント削減することが義務付けられ、これにより赤字は今年の５．４％から、次期大統領任期終了となる２０３２年には２．９％まで削減されるとしている。

同氏は、現在ＧＤＰの１１９％に達している債務が６０％に達するまで赤字は減少し続け、ほぼ均衡状態を維持すると述べた。

国民投票の実施時期や、政府がどのようにしてその水準の削減を達成するかについては具体的に言及しなかった。

しかし、自身が提示した数値は「最低限の目標」としており、６日に概要が示される予定の財政計画では、さらに急速に支出を削減すると付け加えた。

item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅反発し、前営業日比２．５３...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は大幅反発、7万円回復　ＡＩ株が押し上げ 10/5 11:50 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は大幅反発し、前営業日比２．５３％（１７２８円１５銭）高の７万００３７円６１銭となった。米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、今月の米利上げ観測が後退したことを好感する形で日本株は堅調な展開が続いた。指数寄与度の高いＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が相場を押し上げ、日経平均は約３カ月ぶりに大台の７万円を回復した。

・日経平均は前営業日比１．１８％高でスタートした後、上げ幅を拡大。前場中盤に一時２．５８％（１７６２円）高の７万００７２円１３銭まで上昇。

・ＡＩ・データセンター関連株に見直し買いが継続。相場の押し上げ要因となった。

・月次売上高や決算を手掛かりにした個別物色も活発。個別では、アドバンテストが連日の上場来高値を更新。

・一方、プライム市場では４割超の銘柄が値下がり。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは１．１６％高の４１３８．５７ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆７５３８億３８００万円。

・東証３３業種では、電気機器、ガラス・土石製品、精密機器など２５業種が値上がり。海運、石油・石炭製品、電気・ガスなど８業種は値下がりした。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが８３７銘柄（５３％）、値下がりは６５７銘柄（４２％）、変わらずは５８銘柄（３％）。

＜山和証券　調査部部長　志田憲太郎氏＞

「米国の今月の利上げ観測が後退したことで、特に金利上昇がネガティブに働いていたデータセンター関連株に資金が戻ってきている。今月後半からは国内でも決算シーズンが始まるため、業績期待を背景にした買いも入りやすい」

「ただ、中東の紛争が終結に向かうまでは、日経平均が最高値を更新するのは難しいかもしれない。決算では、中東紛争によるコスト高に対して企業がどう対応したか注目される」

item.description: [パリ ３日 ロイター] - 仏自動車大手ルノーのフランソワ・プロボ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は３日、今後５年間にフラ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ルノー、仏でＥＶなどに100億ユーロ超投資へ＝ＣＥＯ 10/5 10:49 配信

７月１５日、フランスのドゥエーで撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Benoit Tessier）

[パリ ３日 ロイター] - 仏自動車大手ルノーのフランソワ・プロボ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は３日、今後５年間にフランス国内で電気自動車（ＥＶ）や、より手頃な価格の車に１００億ユーロ（１１０億ドル）超を投資すると明らかにした。

プロボ氏はラジオ局フランス・アンテールのインタビューで「過去５年間にフランスで１３０億ユーロを投資し、ＥＶに注力するため生産体制を全面的に転換した。今後５年間についても、社会・政治情勢が許せば、再び１００億ユーロ超を投じ、ＥＶの推進と車両価格引き下げへの取り組みを継続する」と述べた。

フランスでは９月に新車登録台数に占めるＥＶの割合が過去最高の４２％に達した。イラン戦争開始以降の燃料価格高騰が需要を押し上げた。

プロボ氏は「実際、現在はフランス国内の工場での生産台数は以前より増えている。２０２５年には国内で５０万台を生産した。２６年にはＥＶの拡大により、少なくとも２５％増産する」と語った。

item.description: BRASILIA: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro will face President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the runoff of a presidential election, after the challenger took some 47 per cent of valid votes in th
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

World

Bolsonaro beats expectations in Brazil presidential vote, faces Lula in runoff

Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and senator Flavio Bolsonaro, the Liberal Party candidate in Brazil's presidential election. (Photos: Reuters/Adriano Machado)

FAST

BRASILIA: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro will face President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the runoff of a presidential election , after the challenger took some 47 per cent of valid votes in the first round on Sunday (Oct 4), beating the forecasts in most private surveys. The two leading candidates will advance to the second round of voting on Oct 25, after topping a field of 12 candidates in a campaign focused on concerns about the growing cost of living, corruption and insecurity in Brazilians' daily lives. Bolsonaro, the son of right-wing former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup after losing the 2022 election, now heads to a showdown with the leftist Lula, who picked up 44.9 per cent of the vote, with nearly 99 per cent of votes reported. Private surveys in the run-up to the election had forecast Lula leading the first-round vote by around three percentage points. Bolsonaro's stronger-than-expected performance will buoy his campaign and may bolster Brazil's currency and stock market, which have risen on the prospects of the business-friendly challenger.

"The pollsters missed badly," said Robert Muggah, cofounder of think tank Igarape Institute. "Expect the runoff polls, which show a dead heat, to understate Bolsonaro as well." A victory for the senator would extend a wave of wins across Latin America by right-wing candidates aligned with US President Donald Trump, while Lula's reelection could be a challenge for Washington, which has clashed with his government over trade and security. Despite growing worries over Brazil's public finances and sluggish economic growth, the campaign offered meagre policy debate, as both leading candidates skipped the major TV debates. SURPRISE SHOWING Early on Sunday, Bolsonaro told journalists in Rio de Janeiro he was counting on "a protest vote from people who would otherwise vote for another candidate but are opposed to Lula". Thaise Lima, a 41-year-old lawyer on her way to vote in Sao Paulo, said her main goal was to get Lula's Workers' Party out of office. "I don't think Flavio is the best candidate, but I might decide to vote for him in the next few minutes," she said, adding that she wished psychiatrist and author Augusto Cury were a more viable candidate. Fernando Tempel, 49, a management consultant, told Reuters he was voting for Bolsonaro despite initially planning to vote for Romeu Zema, the former governor of Minas Gerais state. "The protest vote foreshadows what is to come in the runoff," said political analyst Rafael Favetti. "While this should benefit Flavio Bolsonaro now, his growth potential in the second round drops precisely because that support has already been front-loaded."

Related:

Lula, Bolsonaro trade blows in final scramble for votes in Brazil

ECONOMIC HEADWINDS Despite falling inequality and unemployment, Lula has struggled to win over voters grappling with high living costs, heavy household debt and the threat of crime and more pervasive gang activity. Bolsonaro has sought to capitalise on cost-of-living concerns, while Lula has moved to ban online gambling and, as the race tightened, expanded welfare and proposed fresh debt relief for families. Rising spending and public debt above 82 per cent of GDP have stoked fiscal concerns that Brazil's next president will need to address. The government lowered its economic growth forecasts for this year and next to 2.0 per cent and 2.3 per cent respectively. "I voted for Brazil to start growing again," said Marciano de Souza e Silva, a 52-year-old public servant in Brasilia who voted for Flavio. A strong performance by right-wing candidates in Sunday's Senate election could help Bolsonaro's ability to pass economic reforms, institute a "more well-behaved fiscal policy" and ultimately boost growth if he is elected, said Marco Saravalle, chief investment officer at MSX Invest/Krivo Capital. OVERSHADOWED DEBATE Scandals and fears of foreign interference ahead of the vote largely overshadowed policy debates during the campaign. Controversy surrounding the now-defunct Banco Master has engulfed much of Brazil's political class after Daniel Vorcaro, who ran the bank, was arrested earlier this year and accused of a multibillion-dollar fraud scheme. The investigation has probed the banker's ties to figures from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to the younger Bolsonaro, who is being investigated for money laundering tied to the case by the federal police. Both have dismissed the allegations against them. Throughout the campaign, Lula's allies have warned that the Trump administration might refuse to recognise election results if he wins, pointing to an aborted effort to send US officials to Brazil. "What is at stake is the future of Brazil," Lula said after voting in Sao Bernardo do Campo, in Sao Paulo state. Trump has not formally endorsed a candidate, though he hosted Senator Bolsonaro at the White House and praised him publicly. Reuters reported on Wednesday that Brazilian intelligence officials briefed a French and German delegation on alleged US and Russian interference before the election. The US has rejected claims of interference in Brazil's affairs. On Sunday afternoon, Brazil's electoral court chief Kassio Nunes Marques said the election was running smoothly.

Source: Reuters/nh

item.title: Nasdaq hits record as dollar and Treasury yields climb, oil prices ease
item.description: Wall Street equities were buoyed by advances in mega-cap stocks on Monday, as Treasury yields held near multiyear highs, the dollar advanced against the euro, and oil prices relented.
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Delevingne, Danilo Masoni
item.content:encoded: Wall Street equities were buoyed by advances in mega-cap stocks on Monday, as Treasury yields held near multiyear highs, the dollar advanced against the euro, and oil prices relented. US stock indexes were [USN:L6N45R0YI TEXT:"supported"] by heavyweight technology companies such as Nvidia < NVDA.O >, Meta Platforms < META.O >, and Microsoft < MSFT.O . The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 0.18%, the S&P 500 (.SPX) added about 0.7%, and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained about 1%, touching a fresh [USN:L6N45R124 TEXT:"record high"]. European shares [USN:L4N45R0Y7 TEXT:"closed higher"] even as French equities slid to a six-month low on fiscal concerns and Schneider Electric fell after [USN:L6N45Q07P TEXT:"acquiring"] US software firm PTC. The pan-European STOXX 600 .STOXX > index ended 0.4% higher, after hitting a four-month low last week as global bond yields surged on inflation, higher corporate bond issuances and worsening fiscal outlooks. Latin American markets also [USN:L1N45R0T6 TEXT:"climbed"], led by a rally in Brazilian [USN:L1N45R06Y TEXT:"stocks and the real currency"], after right-wing Senator Flavio [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"Bolsonaro"] outperformed poll predictions in the first round of the presidential election and advanced to a runoff against leftist incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) rose 0.7%. "Relative equity market calm amid the bond market’s 'perfect storm' is understandable, given accelerating economic growth and the AI boom’s rate insensitivity," Lisa Shalett, chief investment officer of Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, said in an email. Shalett wrote that her team was watching three areas for signs of stress: equity market and earnings revisions breadth; high-yield bond spreads; and US dollar strength along with currency market volatility. FRANCE WEIGHS ON THE EURO The euro recovered some ground to trade at $1.122 after falling by as much as 0.8% to a 17-month low of $1.1160. The single currency, down about 2.5% last month, has come under pressure as [USN:L6N45O0HP TEXT:"investors fret"] over France's rising debt and political gridlock ahead of next year's presidential election. The premium investors demand to hold French 10-year bonds over safer German debt surged above [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"150 basis points"] on Friday, fueling concerns of [USN:L8N45R0QJ TEXT:"broader contagion"] across European markets. "France is the real deal in terms of risk premia for the euro," said Saxo strategist Neil Wilson, noting that French government plans to reduce the budget deficit still face parliamentary scrutiny and could ultimately be watered down. French 10-year yields stayed below Friday's peak of 4.993%, while German yields were also little changed. The euro's slide lent fresh support to the dollar, which also drew strength from elevated Treasury yields. The dollar index (.DXY) rose 0.2%. The dollar's resilience suggests it "may be too soon to write off" its long-term role, BlackRock Investment Institute strategists wrote in a note on Monday. They added: "With markets pricing more Fed tightening than we think will materialize, there is limited scope for a sustained dollar bull run." Benchmark 10-year US Treasury yields rose 3.4 basis points to 5.31%. Borrowing costs across major economies remain near multiyear highs as deteriorating public finances, heavy debt issuance and elevated energy prices continue to pressure bond markets. FED REPRICING OFFERS SUPPORT Figures released last week showed [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"US job growth"] slowed more than expected in September and payrolls for the previous two months were revised sharply lower, prompting investors to largely rule out a Federal Reserve rate increase this month. Japan's Nikkei (.N225) rose 2.4% and MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) rose 1.3%. Investors see a roughly 24% chance of a Fed rate increase this month, down from 64% a week ago, according to CME FedWatch data, though a move in December remains largely priced in. [USN:L1N45Q068 TEXT:"Oil prices fell"] on Monday after crude exports from the Middle East increased and the Group of Seven nations pledged to boost supplies, though selling was limited by ongoing disruption fears linked to the US-Israeli war on Iran . Brent crude futures < LCOc1 > settled $1.93, or 1.89%, lower at $100.32 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate crude < CLc1 > lost $1.68, or 1.84%, at $89.43. Spot gold was [USN:L1N45R0RF TEXT:"steady"] at $4,143 an ounce.

FAST

NEW YORK: The United States removed its B-1 bombers from a UK air base one week after several men were arrested there on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, a Pentagon official said on Sunday (Oct 4).  A dozen B-1 bombers were stationed at RAF Fairford air base, located northwest of London. The planes had been used for US strikes on Iran.  "While operational security precluded us from confirming the movement of our assets and forces in real-time, we can acknowledge now that all US bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have redeployed to their home stations in the United States," a Pentagon spokesman wrote in an email. Britain has "strong indications" that Iran was involved in a suspected plot targeting the base, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday. Iran said accusations linking Tehran to the alleged plan were baseless and summoned the British ambassador in Tehran over the issue.

The Wall Street Journal first reported that the aircraft were removed from the base amid security concerns over suspected terror plots against the facility. The British government had allowed the US to use bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz. US President Donald Trump said those involved in the plot had planned "big damage", while US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also pointed to the "hands of a foreign actor".

item.title: Trump says US bombers moved from UK due to threats
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that a threat linked to Iran had prompted the removal of American B-1 bombers from a British airbase.
item.dc:creator: Kate Holton, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that a threat linked to Iran had prompted the removal of American B-1 bombers from a British airbase. The planes had been stationed at RAF Fairford, the preferred European base for US bombers, and had recently been used in US strikes on Iran. Last week, five British men were arrested near the base — which Iran's Revolutionary Guards previously said was a legitimate target — on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts. "We had an idea that there might be a threat, and why would I leave them there? It costs very little money to move them," Trump told reporters on Monday. "So we had a threat, and if we're going to be threatened, we just move them, and that sort of alleviates that. And we actually know the people that made the threat." When asked if they were linked to Iran, Trump responded: "They would be linked to Iran." Earlier on Monday, Vice President JD Vance said the US moved the bombers out of an abundance of caution. "We do feel with some confidence that the Iranians are, you know, they're trying to do what the Iranian state has done for 49 years, which is engaged in acts of terrorism against the United States (and others), so we are being extremely cautious, and that's all I'd say about that," Vance told reporters. However, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was no direct link between the sudden removal of the bombers and the suspected Iranian plot. He said the Pentagon is "constantly reallocating resources where they need to be." A NATO military source had said on Monday: "It is still believed that Iran poses an acute threat to US assets in the UK." While much about [USN:L1N45O076 TEXT:"the incident remains unexplained"], British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said any plot was likely backed by [USN:L1N45O076 TEXT:"Iran"]. Iran has said accusations that it was involved in any plot are baseless, and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi wrote on X: "I can confirm Iran's belief that releasing supposed terrorists working for foreign states really says it all. You're barking up the wrong tree." KEY AIR BASE FOR US STRIKES Rubio said on Monday the US had confidence in the security of all its bases. Fairford, located 90 miles (145 km) west of London, is one of the most important European bases for the US, being one of only a few suitable for heavy bombers such as the B-1 aircraft. It has played a key role in previous US campaigns in the Middle East, although its bombers are not stationed there permanently. During the current conflict, the US had permission to use Fairford only to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz, or so-called defensive strikes. London had refused permission for the US to use British bases for offensive strikes on Iran. That approach has strained ties between the US and Britain, typically one of Washington's closest allies. A Pentagon official confirmed on Sunday that all US bombers that had been deployed to Fairford had headed to their home stations in the US. The Pentagon said the US bomber force remained ready to deliver precision global strike capabilities "anywhere, anytime". The New York Times, citing two US officials, said the US had rushed over the weekend to move the bombers after commanders received new threats about an Iran-backed plot. It said some of the planes had left while aerial refuelling aircraft were still being scrambled. A US official declined to comment. The British government also declined to comment, although a spokesman for Burnham said the base was safe. Christoph Bergs, research analyst at defence think tank the Royal United Services Institute, said the redeployment would in the short term reduce US capacity "to quickly surge sorties against Iran, reducing the threat level somewhat". But he noted that use of Fairford was already limited given London's stipulation on defensive strikes. The aircraft could now potentially be sent to either Diego Garcia or bases in the Gulf, to reduce the need for more air-to-air refuelling to cover the additional distance, but that would depend on capacity availability, negotiations with allies and security, he added. TRUMP SAID PLOT WAS FOR 'BIG DAMAGE' In the early hours of September 27, five British men in their 20s were arrested after being seen running into fields from three white vans parked near the base. Police said no explosive devices were found but a quantity of petrol was present. The men have since been [USN:L1N45P02S TEXT:"released on bail"]. A sixth man, a dual UK-Iranian national arrested on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts four days later, has also been released on bail. Trump said at the time of the first arrests that the plot had [USN:L1N45J01J TEXT:"planned "big damage""] and that it might have been connected to Iran. Trump later said he would not have [USN:L1N45K087 TEXT:"released"] the suspects on bail. A senior NATO military official said the removal of the bombers would have no impact on the alliance: "NATO's defensive agility towards any aggression remains unchanged and unmatched thanks to the unity, strength, and combined capabilities of 32 nations." The Wall Street Journal first reported the removal of the US bombers.

item.title: Flydubai's Omani co-pilot surveyed Ben Gurion airport multiple times, planned to crash plane: Israeli media
item.description: An Omani co-pilot attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30. Passengers and off-duty pilots subdued the attacker and landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Authorities in the ...
item.content:encoded:
Flydubai's Omani co-pilot surveyed Ben Gurion airport multiple times, planned to crash plane: Israeli media An Omani co-pilot attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30. Passengers and off-duty pilots subdued the attacker and landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Authorities in the UAE, Israel, and Australia are investigating his extremist background and potential terror ties. ANI | Updated: 05-10-2026 09:45 IST | Created: 05-10-2026 09:45 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Hamam al-Hammami, the Omani co-pilot behind the September 30 terrorist attack aboard Flydubai Flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, had planned to direct the airliner into Ben Gurion Airport, according to reports published on Sunday by The Times of Israel. Currently detained and undergoing interrogation within the United Arab Emirates, al-Hammami informed investigators that his plan involved operating the flight in a routine manner after incapacitating the captain, securing all mandatory landing clearances, and subsequently crashing into an airport facility or stationed aircraft, as detailed by Hebrew media sources cited by The Times of Israel. By deferring action until the final phase, he calculated he could preclude anyone from recognising the unfolding situation, sounding alarms, or obstructing his objective. According to The Times of Israel, that consideration accounted for why al-Hammami delayed seizing control of the flight deck until the aeroplane traversed Jordanian airspace. His actions were thwarted when Captain Smit Machchhar, despite suffering an assault and stab wounds from al-Hammami, succeeded in unlatching the cockpit portal, allowing a group of Israeli travellers to grapple with and restrain the assailant, while an individual among them steadied the aircraft prior to two off-duty aviators stepping in to assume command of the controls. Reports cited by The Times of Israel indicated that al-Hammami had visited Ben Gurion Airport on multiple occasions during preceding months following flight duties with flydubai. He disclosed to interrogators that during his June arrival, his entire focus concentrated on gathering intelligence and mapping out the assault. He subsequently scheduled the operation for July, though ultimately aborted the initiative at the final juncture due to a personal friendship with a member of the cabin crew. Israeli security personnel have not directly interrogated al-Hammami themselves, with the intelligence being transmitted to Israel via Saudi and Emirati investigative channels, as noted by The Times of Israel. Israel has requested that the UAE broaden its questioning parameters to encompass flight attendants, according to Channel 12 reporting conveyed via The Times of Israel. Meanwhile, Channel 13 reported, as cited by The Times of Israel, that al-Hammami told investigators, “I looked into which airline flies to Tel Aviv. That’s why I chose flydubai. I planned it even before I was accepted.” An earlier account published by the Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera indicated that al-Hammami intended to strike a skyscraper, drawing upon Israeli intelligence assessments, as reported by The Times of Israel. According to that account, which outlined a chronological sequence of events, al-Hammami requested a prayer break at 9:15 am before launching an assault on the pilot using the flight deck's crash hatchet, sparking a violent confrontation as Machchhar fought to unlock the door from within. Around 9:20 am, Tali Manes accompanied her five-year-old child to the washroom area, where she began overhearing the altercation transpiring inside the cockpit. She alerted an off-duty aviator seated within business class. The off-duty captain manipulated the exterior handle as Machchhar managed to release the latch, opening the entryway to expose al-Hammami striking the pilot, the documentation stated. “He’s killing the pilot,” Manes shouted. Recognising that his initial objective was no longer viable, al-Hammami initiated a steep dive at 9:21 am targeting the desert floor, alongside efforts to fracture the guidance mechanisms to hinder any alternative attempts to stabilise the airframe, the overview noted. Nevertheless, several Israeli passengers forced entry into the cockpit, overpowering the perpetrator and levelling the aircraft. Initially, off-duty aviators who intervened to pilot the transport broadcast the 7700 code, signifying a general emergency, at 9:31 am, according to the report. By 9:35 am, al-Hammami had been subdued, and by 9:38 am, the replacement flight crew altered the transponder signal to the more specific 7500 designation, denoting unlawful cockpit intrusion, Corriere della Sera conveyed, in coverage highlighted by The Times of Israel. Saudi air traffic management instructed the aviators to execute an unscheduled touchdown in Tabuk, with the commercial jet making contact with the runway at 10:57 am. The transport carried approximately 180 passengers, predominantly Israeli nationals, alongside the flight crew. The travellers returned home late Wednesday via a chartered repatriation service departing from Saudi Arabia, a nation maintaining no formal diplomatic ties with Israel, while Machchhar and al-Hammami were sent back to the UAE, with Machchhar receiving medical care and the perpetrator facing formal questioning. Separately, the Ynet news site quoted a senior Emirati source indicating that al-Hammami faces the prospect of capital punishment, as referenced by The Times of Israel. The briefing noted that authorities in Abu Dhabi intend to seek the most severe sentence available. It additionally highlighted that Israeli intelligence representatives operated within the United Arab Emirates to participate in the examination of al-Hammami, who holds Omani nationality, according to The Times of Israel. Building on these investigative developments, preliminary Israeli intelligence assessments conveyed to CBS News by individuals acquainted with the situation indicated that the reported hijacking attempt likely constituted a lone-wolf operation. The inquiry remains actively ongoing, with authorities exploring every prospective angle, those knowledgeable sources disclosed to CBS News. Expanding on the timeline, the Wednesday commercial journey operating from Dubai to Tel Aviv neared Israeli airspace when the co-pilot allegedly attacked the flight captain and sought to direct the airframe downward in a crash, statements from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, individuals travelling on the aircraft, and the flight captain confirmed. The captain managed to resist the co-pilot long enough to release the flight deck portal. Subsequently, a collective of Israeli passengers alongside FlyDubai personnel subdued the co-pilot, while two off-duty aviators present onboard successfully secured command of the aircraft to execute the emergency landing in Tabuk. The co-pilot currently remains within the United Arab Emirates, undergoing a subsequent phase of questioning following initial interrogations by Saudi officials when the airliner touched down. Israel has dispatched its own delegation to the UAE to take part in the ongoing inquiry, as noted by CBS News. President Trump indicated on Thursday that the co-pilot could maintain connections to Iran, remarking to CBS News, “based on what I'm hearing.” “We're working on it right now,” Mr. Trump stated to CBS News. “They're being very open with us. I would say the answer, based on what I'm hearing, is yes. But we're working on it right now.” Netanyahu communicated to CBS News on Wednesday that the underlying motivations driving the co-pilot remain undetermined. “I don't think it was a hijacking,” Netanyahu informed “CBS Evening News” anchor Tony Dokoupil, supplementing that, as reported by CBS News, “I think it looks like a suicide attempt.” During a Thursday interview, Netanyahu revealed that Israeli authorities established the co-pilot “underwent Islamist radical indoctrination,” drawing upon “personal information” compiled via ongoing interrogations, according to CBS News. He withheld further specifics regarding the alleged radicalisation, though he informed interviewers that the assailant appeared “suicidal,” noting that after other crew members and passengers restrained him, he shouted, “Kill me, kill me!” Public identification of the flight's co-pilot revealed that his legal name is Hamam al Hamami, multiple sources close to the investigation communicated to CBS News. Al Hamami maintained a brief tenure with Oman Air, participating in junior pilot instruction. Surveillance conducted by Omani state authorities revealed he accessed extremist online portals, informants noted to CBS News, prompting Oman Air to reassign him to administrative duties. An insider reported to CBS News that the pilot tendered his resignation from Oman Air subsequent to his reassignment to desk responsibilities, departing the carrier around 2024. According to sources cited by CBS News, al Hamami previously uploaded digital video footage showcasing El Al Israeli Airlines aircraft stationed in Dubai, concluding the clip with an image depicting Ayman al-Zawahiri, the prominent al Qaeda commander eliminated via an American drone strike in 2022. Al Hamami subsequently relocated to Dubai, where FlyDubai recruited him without conducting background verification checks through Omani state channels, informants explained to CBS News. Although holding Omani citizenship, al Hamami was not born in Oman, the sources stated to CBS News, adding that he spent the majority of his upbringing outside the nation, with his maternal heritage rooted in Syria and his paternal lineage in Oman. Omani state representatives have refrained from formally verifying his nationality in public forums, while insiders suggested to CBS News that dual citizenship status remains a possibility, as such a factor might clarify how he secured authorisation to pilot flights entering Israel. Further details emerging from international investigations, reported by outlets including The Wall Street Journal and CNN, reveal that following the emergency landing, investigators discovered al-Hammami confessed to interrogators that his intention was to deliberately bring down the flight and that he was “not afraid of death.” The 29-year-old Omani national is being probed regarding how he underwent radicalisation and managed to re-enter a commercial cockpit despite extremist affiliations that had previously drawn official scrutiny. Authorities across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Israel are actively investigating whether he operated independently or maintained external ties to foreign entities, with particular focus directed toward Iran. According to the WSJ, al-Hammami’s initial employer, the state-owned carrier Oman Air, barred him from flight duties after discovering his visits to extremist websites, and individuals briefed on his background indicated he subsequently completed a deradicalisation programme before joining FlyDubai in February 2026. Investigators are also scrutinising his background in Syria, evaluating whether his radicalisation began during his youth amid the civil war, while his digital footprint revealed an extensive online record featuring conservative and misogynistic commentary. To probe these international connections further, following reports that al-Hammami had been granted an Australian student visa in 2014, authorities in Canberra have initiated an inquiry, according to The Times of Israel. “The Victorian Joint Counter Terrorism Team (VIC JCTT), comprising the AFP, Victoria Police and ASIO, can confirm it is investigating the man’s links to Australia,” an Australian Federal Police spokesperson stated, according to The Times of Israel, which cited a report from The Guardian. “An update will be provided at an appropriate time,” the spokesperson added. The Times of Israel report cited sources telling ABC News that the co-pilot was issued a student visa in 2014 and studied in Australia between 2015 and 2017, when he left the country. ABC News also reported that al-Hammami’s student visa was cancelled in 2019 because he was not enrolled in any course. The Joint Counter Terrorism Team probe will examine whether the co-pilot was radicalised in Australia, the outlet noted, while CNN reported separately that a previously active LinkedIn profile indicated he undertook remote coursework through Buckinghamshire New University in the United Kingdom. (ANI)

item.title: Iran oil minister resigns, replaced by top executive amid US blockade on Tehran’s exports
item.description: Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned amid a crippling US oil blockade and Middle East war. National Iranian Oil Company chief Hamid Bovard was appointed acting minister as Washington ...
item.content:encoded:
Iran oil minister resigns, replaced by top executive amid US blockade on Tehran’s exports Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned amid a crippling US oil blockade and Middle East war. National Iranian Oil Company chief Hamid Bovard was appointed acting minister as Washington intensifies economic pressure to cut off Tehran's energy revenues. ANI | Updated: 05-10-2026 09:03 IST | Created: 05-10-2026 09:03 IST

Mohsen Paknejad, who has stepped down as Iran's Oil Minister. (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

Iran

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Iranian Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad has resigned from his post, with the National Iranian Oil Company chief stepping in as his temporary replacement as the United States continues to enforce a strict naval blockade on Tehran's petroleum shipments. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accepted the resignation and appointed NIOC head Hamid Bovard as acting oil minister, according to a statement broadcast by state media outlet IRIB. State television broadcast an interview with a spokesperson from the Iranian presidential office, who explained that Paknejad had previously offered to step down "due to personal issues", though his initial departure request was declined. Pezeshkian initially urged the minister to stay on duty, but ultimately approved the resignation after Paknejad maintained his stance. The president subsequently "commended his efforts and sincere service" following the departure. The Strait of Hormuz has turned into a major flashpoint during the ongoing Middle East war. Prior to strikes carried out by the United States and Israel against Iran in late February, the vital maritime corridor managed 20 per cent of worldwide crude oil and liquefied natural gas shipments. In response to Tehran restricting commercial shipping traffic and firing upon vessels deemed to have made unauthorised passages, Washington instituted a counterblockade targeting Iranian ports to halt petroleum exports. The economic strain caused by American measures previously led to lengthy queues forming outside petrol stations across Tehran and various other Iranian cities. Depriving Iran of its oil income remains a core objective of the economic strategy pursued by Washington. The US Treasury revealed fresh sanctions on Friday aimed at Iran's automotive and rail industries under the framework of the "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that these restrictions are designed to further diminish Tehran's financial capacity to sustain the war, noting that Washington is actively working to "drain the regime's revenue once and for all". Bessent added that American pressure targets remaining streams of petroleum income, while the administration maintains that naval blockades and sanctions seek to obstruct crude sales and foreign currency access. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump remarked on Saturday that petroleum prices are declining and asserted that Iran has "virtually given up" ambitions for developing a nuclear weapon, as hostilities reach their eighth month. The intense economic campaign spearheaded by the Trump administration has placed Iran's energy sector at the heart of the war, heightening the impact of Paknejad's departure as Tehran attempts to maintain its vital petroleum revenues. (ANI)

item.title: Lab worker's death from 'unknown infection' sparks plague fears in Russia, hundreds quarantined
item.description: Russian authorities are investigating a lab worker's death from unidentified pneumonia at a Siberian research facility. While officials report a stable public health situation, the incident has ...
item.content:encoded:
Lab worker's death from 'unknown infection' sparks plague fears in Russia, hundreds quarantined Russian authorities are investigating a lab worker's death from unidentified pneumonia at a Siberian research facility. While officials report a stable public health situation, the incident has sparked fears of pneumonic plague and prompted precautionary measures, including close medical monitoring of contacts. ANI | Updated: 05-10-2026 09:02 IST | Created: 05-10-2026 09:02 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

Russia

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Authorities in Russia are responding to an alleged research facility mishap in Siberia following the fatality of a laboratory technician who suffered from an affliction categorised as pneumonia of “unknown” origin, according to CNN. The occurrence unfolded at the Anti-Plague Research Institute situated in Shelekhov near Irkutsk, based on reports from Russian state-run news outlet TASS. Uncertainty persists regarding the specific pathogen involved, as Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s federal body responsible for infectious disease oversight, stated that the staff member received a diagnosis of “pneumonia of unknown aetiology”, indicating an unidentified origin. According to CNN, Rospotrebnadzor maintained that “the sanitary and epidemiological situation in the Irkutsk region, the cities of Irkutsk and Shelekhov is stable”. The agency added that it implemented specialised protocols “in connection with the case of an employee of the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute”. Despite official reassurances, the fatality has sparked anxieties surrounding a potential instance of pneumonic plague. Alexei Tsydenov, leader of the adjacent republic of Buryatia, noted that the deceased 28-year-old female worker perished “possibly from the plague”, while emphasising to CNN that “there are no plague outbreaks” within Buryatia. Following an emergency gathering of the local anti-epidemic council alongside Russia’s primary state medical officer, Irkutsk Governor Igor Kobzev appealed for public composure on Friday. As reported by CNN, Kobzev explained that the session connected to a “suspected case of a particularly dangerous infection affecting a resident of the region”. Additional safety steps have similarly been established across the vicinity of Shelekhov. An industrial aluminium facility situated close to the research centre directed personnel to utilise face coverings. Artem Fominikh, who heads the Irkutsk Aluminium Plant, advised individuals to stay tranquil amidst circulating speculation, stating via CNN that “there are many rumours and conflicting reports circulating”. “All identified close contacts are under medical supervision. At present, they show no signs of the disease, and their laboratory test results are negative,” Fominikh remarked, according to CNN. CNN additionally noted that unverified accounts from the independent local publication Liudi Baikala suggested nearly 200 individuals faced monitoring procedures at the Shelekhov medical facility where the lab worker received treatment. The publication further indicated that isolation protocols were enacted at a minimum of one maternity facility inside the municipality. Such lockdown claims have heightened apprehension about the event, even as Russian officials insist the public health climate stays steady. Gennady Onishchenko, previously leading Rospotrebnadzor, expressed his assessment that the Siberian pathogen was “most likely not the plague”, asserting further that even if the plague were verified, “there will be no spread of this disease”. Pneumonic plague represents one of three variants of plague triggered by the bacterium Yersinia pestis. Contrary to alternative strains usually transmitted via interaction with tainted fleas, fauna, or contaminated tissues, pneumonic plague targets the respiratory system and is capable of transmitting between humans via airborne respiratory droplets, drawing on details referenced by CNN. Individuals suffering from pneumonic plague commonly experience elevated temperatures, cranial discomfort, and fatigue, preceding fast-onset pneumonia, breathing difficulties, thoracic discomfort, coughing fits, and occasionally blood-tinged or fluid-like secretions, per documentation from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. (ANI)

item.title: Why Philosophers Are Worried About AI
item.description: Debate over artificial intelligence has largely focused on whether machines could become too powerful. Harvard philosopher Michael Sandel argues that a more immediate question is whether AI changes humans themselves: weakening authentic connection, independent thought and the ways people understand meaning and purpose. Universities are already confronting that challenge as students increasingly use AI to learn and communicate, while Vanderbilt University Chancellor Daniel Diermeier argues that technological fluency must be paired with the ability to think independently. University of Notre Dame philosophy professor Meghan Sullivan takes that question beyond the classroom, examining the ethical responsibility of the companies building AI and the role individuals have in deciding how the technology enters their everyday lives. (Source: Bloomberg)
